bxsj.reason: ShuJian MUD family base. Status corrected from a stale 'limited' -- this lib's own NOTES.md documents a full native-driver deep functional test (2026-07-24) that played through registration, movement, character info, combat (the muren training-dummy safe-sparring mechanism), and menpai/skill systems as an ordinary new player, finding and fixing one real bug along the way (cmds/usr/top.lpc's add_rank() family: an unbounded per-hour rank-decay loop that blew the eval-cost limit on every single quit/top command once the archive's genuine 2008-era shipped rank data was booted against a modern wall clock -- capped at 240 iterations). Only shop/economy and death/respawn were flagged as not conclusively live-tested (a live-run gap, not a known-broken caveat). The lib's own README documents no caveat and none was found. This pass re-verified the pre-seeded admin account's login under the current WASM driver build (fluffos/Mud@2026, 'look'/'score'/'quit' all clean, '您目前的权限是：(admin)') -- fresh registration was not re-run this pass since NOTES.md's 2026-07-24 deep test already covers it end-to-end; a sibling in the same codebase family (bxsj1) had its full registration flow (id -> confirm -> password x2 -> Chinese name -> talent roll -> email -> gender) re-verified fresh this pass with identical results.

chongshengdeshijie.description: RWlib v1.0.1，台湾团队开发的生活模拟/城市经营类 MUD，与本项目其他武侠类 mudlib 完全不属于同一谱系，是一套独立自制的引擎。

chongshengdeshijie.reason: GPLv2 BIG5 life-sim, distinct lineage (RWlib v1.0.1, a large kernel-mudlib codebase with ~70 preloaded system daemons, completely unrelated to this project's wuxia/martial-arts libs). Previously classified 'noboot': a 2026-07-23 re-verification pass found system/kernel/simul_efun/ansi.lpc's ANSI-color handling calls pcre_replace_callback()/pcre_replace()/pcre_match_all() directly from the BOOT-CRITICAL simul_efun file itself, and the WASM build at that time shipped without the pcre package at all (documented in fluffos's own docs/build-wasm.md) -- fluffos_boot() failed outright with "No program in object '/system/kernel/simul_efun'!", not producing any transcript, a genuine driver-capability gap rather than a mudlib bug. Re-tested this session against the current WASM driver build and confirmed docs/build-wasm.md now documents PCRE support was added ("the pcre package is on, so its tests run for real") -- this lib now boots completely cleanly with no code changes needed. Confirmed via a full continuous session: boots through all ~70 preloaded systems (a handful of purely socket-dependent daemons -- dict_d, ftp_d, http_client_d, im_d, realnews_d, smtp_d, socket_d, socket_ob, translate_d, whois_d -- fail to compile and are skipped, exactly as tolerated elsewhere in this project, none of them boot-blocking); reaches the GB/BIG5 charset prompt and English-ID prompt; a full NEW player registration (id -> name -> password + confirm -> email -> gender) completes end-to-end and enters the starting room (巫師神殿) with a newbie-tip message; the pre-existing admin account (fluffos, seeded in an earlier WASM-enablement pass into system/kernel/data/secure.o's wizards mapping) logs in via the loopback-triggered wizard-login auto-redirect (enter the ID a second time when re-prompted, then the admin password) and reaches the wizard-only starting room (巫師大廳) with the '由<Admin/...>連線進入' system banner confirming admin rank; quit is clean from both flows ('你離開遊戲了'). This lib's earlier WASM-enablement pass (loopback-allow gates, throttle exemption, admin seeding into secure.o) is unchanged and still applies -- no further code changes were needed this pass, purely a status correction now that the upstream driver capability gap has closed.

dfgsiiv13b.description: 一個 1994-2000 年間由 Annihilator 開發的台灣 ES2 血統 MUD（正體中文），登入橫幅另稱「天朝帝國 / Celestial Empire」。
dfgsiiv13b.name: 東方故事II v1.3b
dfgsiiv13b.reason: ES2-lineage codebase (Taiwan, 1994-2000, Annihilator), Traditional Chinese. MAJOR encoding finding: the initial convert_lib.sh pass decoded this archive as GB18030, which -- being a superset covering nearly all byte sequences -- silently 'succeeded' on this BIG5-encoded content without ever erroring, producing complete mojibake (Bopomofo-range garbage, e.g. 'ㄏノ祅祘' for what BIG5 decodes as '使用者' 使用者注册程式') instead of a decode failure the pipeline could have caught. Re-ran the whole raw->work conversion with BIG5 instead (verified against the raw .c source with a quick Python decode trial across big5/gbk/gb18030/cp950 before committing to BIG5). Also needed: (1) master.lpc's connect(int port) switches on a hardcoded MUD_PORT (4000, the mudlib's original default) instead of this project's actually-assigned port (40144) -- every single connection was rejected regardless of WASM (driver log: 'Can not accept connection ... due to error in connect()'), fixed by updating the MUD_PORT macro; (2) master.lpc's valid_read/valid_write recursively load_object(SECURITY_D) with no re-entrancy guard -- textbook §7.1, caused 'Too deep recursion' on the very first security check, fixed with the documented re-entrancy-flag pattern; (3) adm/daemons/userid.lpc (identd/RFC1413 lookup, pure socket) gutted per §7.52; (4) is_chinese()'s classic GBK byte-pair check (strlen>=2 required) rejected single-character and odd-length slices under the Unicode codepoint model, blocking any 1 or 3-character Chinese name -- fixed to a CJK codepoint range check. Re-applied a previously-committed native fix (removing a #define MUD_NAME that collides with this driver's auto-predefined MUD_NAME, §7.39) that the BIG5 re-conversion had wiped out by regenerating work/ from raw/ -- checked git history for what else that commit touched before reapplying, only globals.h. Admin (fluffos/Mud@2026) seeded via real registration + a freshly-created adm/etc/wizlist (none shipped in the archive).

dtxywzxzb.reason: 西游记-lineage codebase (大唐西游/Journey of the East). Full WASM pass: (1) adm/daemons/convertd.lpc's Greek-table stray backslash bug (§6.6, ~45 occurrences, exactly the documented pattern) blocked simul_efun's compile; fixed with the documented CRLF-aware sed. (2) A two-files-same-purpose trap (§7.56-class): there's BOTH a /daemons/logind.lpc (dead-code duplicate, no LOGIN_D-macro reference anywhere) and the real /adm/daemons/logind.lpc that LOGIN_D actually resolves to -- initially traced the wrong one and got a completely different (and shorter) registration flow; the real file has extra steps the dead-code copy lacks (a separate 管理密码/'super password' step with stricter complexity rules, sandwiched between the Chinese name and the regular login password, plus a post-gender attribute-reroll menu). (3) The GB/BIG5 encoding menu (§8.7's 'second mechanism shape', local int-flag override + convertd.lpc byte-pair table) WAS a live bug here -- selecting BIG5 spammed 'Invalid GB code' and corrupted output, since the table assumes raw GB2312 bytes and this codebase is now UTF-8 throughout; fixed by mapping both menu choices to encode=0 (the passthrough this family's convertd.lpc already treats as safe). Admin (fluffos/Mud@2026) seeded via real registration + adm/etc/wizlist.

ffxymud.reason: 时空游侠录 (Roaming Swordsman)-lineage codebase, banner reads 非凡公子/新月传奇录II. No mudlib bugs found -- boots and plays cleanly under WASM with zero code changes needed. The one gate: get_id() requires the FIRST input after the id prompt to literally be the client-version string "shikongyouxia3.0" (a fixed magic-string check, not encrypted) before it asks for the real English id -- send that first or every registration attempt gets '你的客户端版本有问题' and disconnects. Formatter's blind-spot-3 CJK-respacing check caught two genuine corruptions (d/huashan/map.lpc, an ASCII-art zone map -- same shape as cctx's; d/player/fyue_room.lpc, a room description where the formatter's tokenizer lost sync) among ~25 false positives -- reverted both rather than hand-repairing. Also noted but NOT fixed: d/city/sj.lpc (an unreachable, unreferenced room -- no other file links to it) has pre-existing missing string quotes throughout (bareword Chinese text where string literals belong, e.g. add_action(do_out, out) instead of add_action("do_out", "out")) predating this project's conversion; would fail to compile if ever loaded, but never blocks the registration/gameplay/quit loop since nothing reaches it. Admin (fluffos/Mud@2026) seeded via real registration + adm/etc/wizlist.

fqyy2.name: 风起云涌2
fqyy2.reason: extracted from a nested rar-inside-rar (the outer archive contained a 风起云涌.rar which itself contained the real mudlib root, folder-named xkx2); no master-hash match to any other lib in this collection; boots clean with zero fixes needed. Full WASM pass: same haiyang/hy-lineage bug set (this lib's SECURITY_D also points to adm/daemons/securd.lpc) -- added loopback-allow to band.lpc; fixed the euid-reset-by-stray-seteuid(getuid()) bug in logind.lpc (create()/make_body()/howmany_user()); guarded howmany_visitor()/howmany_card() against missing counter files; fixed check_legal_name()'s stale GBK byte-length bounds and dropped the i%2==0 gate; guarded securd.lpc's get_status() against the reentrant-compile crash. New bug (same class as hy5): adm/daemons/network/dns_master.lpc called socket_create/socket_bind/socket_close/socket_write unconditionally across 3 functions, failing to compile the whole file -- and since gb_big5()-equivalent boot flow transitively touches this daemon, the compile failure silently broke input_to(get_id) registration for every connection. Gutted the socket-dependent function bodies to no-ops per AGENTS.md §7.52. Admin seeded into adm/daemons/securd.o's wiz_status mapping (CR-per-key encoding, binary-mode file I/O). Registration through world-entry and admin recognition both verified.

fys.description: 档案名叫"风云三"，但实际登入横幅是"铁血江湖"——内容与档案名无关，只是命名不一致。

fys.reason: Archive named 风云三 but the actual in-game banner reads 铁血江湖 (unrelated content, just a filename mismatch). is_chinese() was already fixed to a CJK codepoint check in this archive, but check_legal_name()'s length bounds (strlen<4||>8) and its byte-stepping loop (i%2==0 gate, name[i..<0] tail-slice) were still the stale GBK byte-pair assumption underneath, silently rejecting every real Chinese name including the standard 2-char test name -- fixed the bounds to match the character-count the error message already claimed (2-6) and the loop to per-character slicing (§8.1). quit.lpc enforces a genuine 30-real-second post-login cooldown (game design, not a bug) -- needed a longer idle/filler-send budget in testing to observe it complete rather than just the immediate notify_fail rejection. Formatter's blind-spot-3 CJK-respacing check caught 6 genuine corruptions (5 ASCII-art zone map files plus one help-text file where the tokenizer lost sync) among ~20 total flags -- reverted all 6 rather than hand-repairing. Admin (fluffos/Mud@2026) seeded via real registration + adm/etc/wizlist.

Fixed the classic §8.1 GBK Chinese-name bug in both is_chinese() (byte-range check + strlen>=2 requirement) and check_legal_name() (length bounds mismatched the error message's own stated 1-5 character range, plus the byte-stepping i%2==0 tail-slice loop) -- silently rejected every real Chinese name including the standard 2-char test name. GB/BIG5 encoding menu tested live with both options; renders clean, not a live bug here. Formatter's blind-spot-3 check caught one genuine corruption (daemon/damage-1.lpc, a plaintext combat-log data table collapsed and respaced) among a handful of false positives -- reverted. Admin (fluffos/Mud@2026) seeded via real registration + adm/etc/wizlist.

fyzfqyy.description: 一个以古龙小说为背景的"风云"MUD。
fyzfqyy.name: 风云之风起云涌
fyzfqyy.reason: 风云 (Gu Long novel-themed), two-password (admin + login) registration flow. New finding, catalogued as AGENTS.md §7.60: master.lpc's log_error() -- called for every ordinary compile WARNING, not just real errors -- ends with CHANNEL_D->do_channel(...); if CHANNEL_D hasn't been preloaded yet (true for whichever files sit before it in adm/etc/preload), that call silently triggers a nested compile of channeld.lpc from inside the caller's still-in-progress compile, which this driver forbids -- caught, re-thrown as '*Object cannot be loaded during compilation.', and re-logged through log_error() again, producing tens of thousands of lines of repeated trace dumps for what was originally a harmless pragma warning on the first couple of preloaded files. Bounded to the boot window before CHANNEL_D loads (harmless once boot completes) but drowns real output badly enough to be worth fixing -- guarded with find_object(CHANNEL_D) before the broadcast. Also fixed the classic §8.1 GBK Chinese-name bug in both is_chinese() and check_legal_name() (length bounds + byte-stepping loop, silently rejected every real Chinese name). Formatter's blind-spot-3 check caught 2 genuine corruptions (a wizard-training-quiz text file and a code-cheatsheet file with unescaped trailing Chinese annotations) among 12 flags -- reverted both. Admin (fluffos/Mud@2026) seeded via real registration + adm/etc/wizlist.

hc.description: 源自 2026-07-29 批量归档 `mudlib.rar` 中的 `红尘.rar`（游戏内全名"红尘录"）。ES II 引擎家族的一支独立作品。
hc.name: 红尘
hc.reason: ES II lineage, standalone; from 2026-07-29 bulk mudlib.rar drop. Native boot was already verified in an earlier pass (see NOTES.md); this WASM pass fixed two WASM-specific gaps the native driver doesn't hit: (1) include/restart.h was genuinely empty (0 bytes) in both the raw archive and converted source -- a pre-existing incomplete-source bug, not a conversion artifact -- leaving adm/daemons/restartd.lpc's SHUTDOWN/REBOOT/HALT/CALLOUT_INTERVAL/RESTART_INTERVAL undefined; reconstructed all six constants from the daemon's own usage (restartd.lpc is preloaded but non-critical, so this was previously masked at boot). (2) adm/daemons/logind.lpc's very first per-connection message used socket_address(ob) (sockets-package efun, undefined on this driver) to extract the connecting port; switched to query_ip_port(ob), a real efun already used elsewhere in the codebase. Also upgraded the admin wizlist entry from the previously-seeded 'fluffos (admin)' to 'fluffos (boss)' -- this lineage's wiz_levels ranks (boss) above (admin) as the true top tier, and (boss) is confirmed present in securityd.lpc's trusted_read/trusted_write['/'] tables. Full registration (id->confirm->Chinese name->password->confirm->gift roll->email->gender) -> enter world -> look -> score -> quit verified working, admin id 'fluffos' shows (boss) and update succeeded pre-formatter. LPC formatter run across all 10328 files; reverted 2 files with confirmed stray-corruption (cmds/adm/hbless.lpc, d/city/diaoyuchi1.h -- both had the classic \ n / unquoted-CJK-string corruption from already-unbalanced quotes) and 1 file with confirmed CJK re-spacing corruption (d/player/fyue_room.lpc), found via a same-text-despaced-matches-old-file scan across all 112 files the formatter touched with CJK-space-CJK sequences -- the other 109 were pre-existing author spacing, unchanged by the diff. Post-formatter re-verified: clean boot, zero compile errors, registration and (boss) permission display both still correct.

hell.description: 游戏内标题为 "REVIVE OF ULTRA HELL(BLOOD & MAGIC) FROM 1999.11.13"（作者自称"doing"），是一个 Doing 血统的大型金庸题材 mudlib（超过 7000 个LPC 文件）。

hell.reason: Doing-lineage large-scale jinyong-themed mudlib (7000+ LPC files), in-game titled REVIVE OF ULTRA HELL(BLOOD & MAGIC) FROM 1999.11.13. Bugs fixed: (1) missing local log/nosave/ dir disconnected every new connection during logon(); (2) check_legal_id()'s while(i--) loop silently accepted an empty English id, which later crashed sprintf("%c", my_id[0]) on the empty string (new AGENTS.md §7.62); (3) classic §8.1 GBK byte-range is_chinese() bug; (4) three independent byte-doubled length-bound bugs (check_legal_name's surname/name bounds, the combined surname+name minimum, and named.lpc's invalid_new_name() sliding-window dedup checks) all fixed per the established §8.1 halving pattern; (5) the §7.12-class message() exclude-arg bug lived in the message() wrapper itself, not just tell_room() -- channeld.lpc's do_channel() and questd.lpc's collect_all_quest_information() both crashed independently (new AGENTS.md §7.61); (6) §7.50 is_killing(ob) object-vs-string bug in accept_kill(), 4th confirmed lineage; (7) versiond.lpc's 13 socket-touching functions gutted per §7.52 (near-byte-identical to zjmudhell/shujian3's copy), fixing a logon()-time crash disconnecting every new user. Admin (fluffos/Mud@2026, admin password Mud@2026Adm) seeded via real registration + adm/etc/wizlist, confirmed via visible in-game 目前权限：(admin) display. Full registration->look->score->quit flow verified twice (before and after the LPC formatter pass), with a real Chinese name.

hhsj.description: 源自 2026-07-29 批量归档 `mudlib.rar` 中的 `洪荒世界(自连数据库)`。与`nitan170911`（仙剑奇侠传）、`nitan6`（笑傲江湖）同源的 NT/nitan/Lonely引擎家族成员，这次以《封神演义》/盘古开天为背景重新设计。
hhsj.name: 洪荒世界
hhsj.reason: NT/nitan/Lonely lineage, sibling of nitan170911 (byte-identical master.c/dbase.c) -- ported nitan170911's full §15 dbase-architecture fix series in an earlier native-boot pass. This WASM pass found and fixed the real root cause of that earlier pass's unresolved 'update command returns default fail message' open item: adm/daemons/named.lpc's create() called an unguarded restore() on its own corrupted ~168KB save file (Illegal mapping format), throwing uncaught -- on this driver an uncaught create() error leaves the object permanently non-resident, and a later implicit NAME_D->invalid_new_name(...) call-string invocation on the still-unloaded object silently does nothing at all (no error, no retry) instead of auto-compiling it. Since get_char() (character creation) calls that function before ever reaching make_body()/enter_world(), EVERY new character creation silently died there -- no crash, no visible error -- leaving the connection wedged with no command path ever set, so every subsequent command (not just wizard commands) hit the generic 'what?' fail message forever. This affected ALL players, not just the admin account; the earlier native pass's diagnosis (a command-search-path gap specific to wizard verbs) was incomplete, understandably so since write()-based debugging couldn't distinguish 'call silently no-ops' from 'verb not found'. Fixed with the standard §7.41 corrupted-save-data guard: catch(restore()) in named.lpc's create(). Found via write()-based bisection through get_char() (log_file() doesn't persist across separate WASM invocations, so had to use write() in the real interactive input_to context instead). Also upgraded the wizlist entry from fluffos (admin) to fluffos (boss) -- this lineage's wiz_levels ranks (boss) above (admin) as the actual top tier, confirmed present in securityd.lpc's trusted_read/trusted_write['/']. Verified: full registration -> look/score -> fluffos routed to wizard rest room (巫师休息室) confirming (boss) status recognized -> update succeeds. LPC formatter run across all 24177 files; reverted 5 files with confirmed CJK re-spacing corruption found via a same-text-despaced-matches-old-file scan across 287 formatter-touched files; also directly diff-reviewed all 6 map.lpc ASCII-art zone-map files (box-drawing art doesn't match the CJK regex) -- all 6 clean, only cosmetic reformatting. Post-formatter re-verified clean.

hxxtjqb.reason: Journey-to-the-West-themed ES-lineage mudlib (MudOS v22pre11 MudLib Build 3310), in-game titled 西行战记, with a live GB/BIG5 dual-encoding menu at connect time. Bugs fixed: (1) classic §6.6 convertd.lpc Greek-table stray-backslash bug, 45 occurrences, crashing the banner cat() on every connection; (2) classic §8.1 check_legal_name() byte-doubled length bounds + i%2==0 gate + tail-slice bug in logind.lpc (is_chinese() itself was already correctly codepoint-based); (3) live GB/BIG5 encoding-menu bug (§8.7) -- BIG5 selection produced 'Invalid GB code' spam on every subsequent line, fixed by mapping both menu choices to the GB passthrough encoding. Admin (fluffos/Mud@2026) seeded via real registration + adm/etc/wizlist, confirmed via visible 目前权限：(admin) display. Full registration->look->score->quit flow verified twice (before and after the LPC formatter pass) with a real Chinese name (秦风). Formatter run found 2 files (d/moon/obj/poem.lpc, u/bmw/task/taskd.lpc) with pre-existing broken/corrupted string literals predating this pass (an unterminated poem string and a literal pager-output artifact baked into the source) -- reverted the formatter's respacing on both rather than compounding pre-existing corruption; left otherwise unfixed as out of scope for a WASM verification pass.

hy.description: 以"金庸小说背景"为世界观的武侠 MUD（请勿使用小说中人名），社区名"情义盟"。
hy.name: 海洋（基础版）
hy.reason: 海洋 (haiyang) themed, distinct codebase from hy2000 (079)/hy2002 (080)/hy5 -- master hash doesn't match any existing lib, no confirmed lineage; finished an interrupted conversion (leftover static keyword, uppercase .C files), removed a duplicate-create() textual ftpd.lpc include (§7.40), and guarded master.lpc's creator_file/domain_file/author_file() against a load-during-compile recursion (find_object(SIMUL_EFUN_OB) check) that otherwise crashed boot entirely. Full WASM pass: fixed is_chinese() codepoint bug, check_legal_name() length bounds, added loopback-allow to band.lpc, fixed a genuine typo in adm/daemons/securityd.lpc (unrelated dead-code duplicate of the real security daemon adm/daemons/securd.lpc -- SECURITY_D macro actually points at securd.lpc). Two deeper bugs found and fixed in adm/daemons/logind.lpc: (1) create() left the daemon's euid unset, and a later seteuid(getuid()) call in howmany_user()/make_body() reset it back to empty mid-registration since the daemon's real uid never resolves either -- fixed all three call sites to seteuid(ROOT_UID) explicitly; (2) howmany_visitor()/howmany_card() crashed via sscanf(0,...) whenever their counter files (/log/mud/MUDVISITOR, GIFTCARD) don't exist yet -- a real first-boot bug since libs/*/work/**/log is gitignored, not just a WASM-sandbox artifact -- fixed by returning 0 when read_file() returns falsy. Also fixed a reentrant-compile crash in adm/daemons/securd.lpc's get_status(): member_array(euid, wiz_levels) crashes when called on the object before its own variable initializers finish (wiz_levels declared after wiz_status, so a reentrant call during create()'s restore()->valid_read() chain sees it still unset) -- guarded with arrayp(wiz_levels). Admin seeded directly in adm/daemons/securd.o's saved wiz_status mapping (NOT /adm/etc/wizlist, which this lineage's real security daemon never reads) -- edited with binary-mode file I/O since this lineage encodes '/' as a literal CR (0x0D) byte in mapping keys, which Python's default text-mode newline translation would silently mangle into LF. Registration through world-entry fully verified for both a plain player and the fluffos/admin account (admin-only entry notices confirmed firing); post-login look/score/quit echo occasionally raced against async entry-banner call_outs in scripted WASM tests (same class of harmless test-harness timing artifact as nt6/nt6nitan6win), not a mudlib bug.

hy2000.description: 游戏内标题为"海洋II"（Ocean II），ES2/金庸题材血统的 mudlib。和`fqyy2`（风起云涌2）同属"海洋/hy"代码线家族（`SECURITY_D` 都指向`adm/daemons/securd.lpc`）。
hy2000.name: 海洋2000 (hy2000)
hy2000.reason: ES2/jinyong-lineage mudlib, in-game titled 海洋II (Ocean II). Bugs fixed: (1) stale MASTER_OB/SIMUL_EFUN_OB macros pointed at /adm/single/ dead-code duplicates instead of /adm/obj/ (the real files per config.fluffos, §7.56-class); (2) §7.54-class sscanf(read_file(missing_file)) crash in logind.lpc's howmany_visitor()/howmany_card() reading /log/mud/MUDVISITOR and GIFTCARD on a fresh checkout; (3) new §7.54 addendum: write(read_file(missing_file)) crash in uptime.lpc's LASTCRASH display, blocking the id prompt from ever appearing at all (no compile error, no catchable exception -- silently prevented registration from starting); (4) new AGENTS.md §7.63: quit.lpc's new('/clone/topten/magic-rice') was missing the defensive if(ob=new(...)) guard that every sibling call site (top10.lpc, topboard.lpc, topten.lpc, topdel.lpc -- the last of which has a comment acknowledging the exact failure) already has, crashing every quit with a bad call_other on int 0; fixed by matching the sibling pattern rather than chasing the underlying new()-failure root cause (extensive investigation confirmed the file compiles cleanly and create() never even starts executing -- a pre-existing driver/mudlib quirk the original authors already defended against everywhere except this one call site). ADMIN BOOTSTRAP DEVIATES FROM THE USUAL PATTERN: securd.lpc hardcodes a bootstrap admin id 'wuyou' directly in restore_list() (set("wiz_status/wuyou","(admin)")) instead of using the plain-text adm/etc/wizlist file most other libs in this collection use. Admin account registered as id 'wuyou' (Chinese name 无忧) with password Mud@2026, confirmed via visible 目前权限：(admin) display. Full registration->look->score->quit flow verified twice (before and after the LPC formatter pass) with a real Chinese name. Formatter run found 1 file (cmds/usr/setbak.lpc) with genuine corruption inside a heredoc help-text block (every Chinese character respaced) -- reverted via git checkout.

hy2002.description: 游戏内标题为"海洋II"（Ocean II），是 [hy2000](../hy2000/) 的后续/演进版本——两者 10630/10632 个文件按路径完全重合，hy2002 在此基础上新增了约 3000 个文件（新地图、新门派内容等）。
hy2002.name: 海洋2002 (hy2002)
hy2002.reason: Evolved/later sibling of hy2000 (10630/10632 of hy2000's files shared by path; hy2002 is a superset with ~3000 additional files) -- same ES2/jinyong-lineage 海洋II (Ocean II) codebase. Bugs fixed, several proactively applied from the known hy2000 fix set and confirmed present here too: (1) stale MASTER_OB/SIMUL_EFUN_OB macros pointed at /adm/single/ dead-code duplicates (§7.56-class); (2) §7.54-class sscanf(read_file(missing_file)) crashes in logind.lpc's howmany_visitor()/howmany_card() and uptime.lpc's LASTCRASH display; (3) §7.52-class socket gutting in adm/daemons/network/dns_master.lpc's startup_udp()/send_udp()/the socket_close() line in send_shutdown() -- CRITICAL here because DNS_MASTER->query_muds()/query_svc() are called mid-flow in logind.lpc's gb_big5(), so the daemon failing silently aborted the rest of gb_big5() including the final id-prompt write(), blocking registration entirely with zero visible error; (4) classic §8.1 check_legal_name() byte-doubled bounds (4/10 chars -> 2/5) plus the i%2==0 gate and name[i..<0] tail-slice in logind.lpc (is_chinese() itself was already correct). Both GB and BIG5 encoding menu choices confirmed working live, no fix needed. Admin bootstrap deviates from the usual wizlist pattern AND from hy2000's: securd.lpc hardcodes bootstrap admin id 'hxsd' directly in restore_list(), but that id is ALREADY an existing archived player account with an unknown password (new AGENTS.md §1.5 bug class) -- added a parallel set("wiz_status/fluffos","(admin)") line, registered fluffos/Mud@2026Pass1 normally, confirmed via visible 目前权限：(admin) display. Full registration->look->score->quit flow verified twice (before and after the LPC formatter pass) with a real Chinese name. Formatter run found 2 genuinely corrupted files (cmds/usr/setbak.lpc heredoc help text, and help/help/menpai.lpc a plaintext help-content file collapsed to one line with every character respaced) -- both reverted via git checkout. Note a real 60-second same-IP anti-abuse rate limit between new-character registrations (§10.1-class intentional design, not a bug).

hy3.name: 火云 (hy3)
hy3.reason: ES/jinyong-lineage mudlib, in-game titled 火云录2000 (Huo Yun Lu 2000). Bugs fixed: (1) classic §8.1 is_chinese() GBK byte-range bug in the REAL adm/simul_efun/chinese.lpc -- a stale dead-code duplicate at adm/single/chinese.lpc already had the fix applied (classic §7.56-class trap, the real included file still had the bug); (2) classic §8.1 check_legal_name() byte-doubled bounds (2/10 -> 1/5 chars) plus the i%2==0 gate and name[i..<0] tail-slice in adm/daemons/logind.lpc; (3) NEW critical bug (AGENTS.md §7.59 variant): adm/obj/master.lpc's valid_read/valid_write wrapper unconditionally overwrote the driver-provided user argument with previous_object() for EVERY func including load_object/include, silently denying compiles of the player's own body class mid-registration -- the crash was completely invisible (no error, no compile warning) until the suspect call was wrapped in catch() to surface '*Read access denied.'; fixed by exempting func=="load_object"/"include" from the override, the same pattern as the original §7.59; (4) admin-login bug in adm/daemons/wzd_log.lpc: its anti-hijack IP-verification system uses regexp() (real regex syntax, not glob) to match connecting IPs against a per-admin whitelist -- an initial attempt at whitelisting the test admin id with glob syntax ('*.*.*.*') crashed with an invalid-regex error, silently killing the rest of wzd_log() with zero visible symptom; fixed using valid regex ('.*') instead. Admin login from unrecognized IPs normally requires solving a live random math challenge shown on screen (an intentional, well-designed anti-hijack feature, not a bug) -- this was bypassed for the standard fluffos test account via the ip whitelist mapping rather than attempting to solve it live. Both GB and BIG5 encoding menu choices confirmed working live, no fix needed. Full registration->look->score->quit flow verified twice (before and after the LPC formatter pass) with a real Chinese name, and the admin flow (fluffos/loginpass1, 目前权限：(admin)) reverified after formatting too.

hy5.description: "海洋"系列的另一支代码线（与 146/hy 同源但代码内容已大幅分叉，行数差异很大，不能假设两者的具体修复位置/行号一致）。世界观为武侠向，社区自称"海洋V"。
hy5.name: 海洋5
hy5.reason: same lineage as 146 (hy, base haiyang archive) -- same duplicate-create() ftpd.lpc fix (§7.40) and author_file() recursion guard; finished an interrupted conversion (58882-file archive originally timed out mid-convert); fixed efun::message() exc_target=0 rejection in tell_room(); boots clean. Full WASM pass: added loopback-allow to band.lpc's is_banned(); fixed the same euid-reset-by-stray-seteuid(getuid()) bug as 146/hy in adm/daemons/logind.lpc (create(), howmany_user(), make_body() all changed to seteuid(ROOT_UID)); guarded howmany_visitor()/howmany_card() against missing counter files; fixed check_legal_name()'s stale GBK byte-length bounds (4-10 -> 2-5, dropped the i%2==0 gate, is_chinese() called per-character); guarded adm/daemons/securd.lpc's get_status() against the same reentrant-compile member_array() crash as 146/hy (arrayp(wiz_levels) check). Also found a NEW bug not present in 146/hy: adm/daemons/network/dns_master.lpc's startup_udp()/send_udp()/send_shutdown() call socket_create/socket_bind/socket_close unconditionally (no sockets package under WASM), failing to COMPILE the whole file -- since gb_big5() transitively touches this daemon, the compile failure silently broke the entire registration flow (no input_to(get_id) ever registered, so all further input fell through to the ordinary command parser). Fixed by gutting the socket-dependent bodies to no-ops, same pattern as §7.52's mudlistd.lpc. Admin seeded directly into adm/daemons/securd.o's wiz_status mapping (same non-wizlist mechanism as 146/hy), edited with binary-mode file I/O. Registration through world-entry and admin recognition both verified; this lineage's Big5 prompt actually expects g/gb or b/big5 (not y/n) -- do not assume the same prompt semantics as a similarly-worded 146/hy prompt.

hyiishzdscbb.archive: 海洋II上海站第三次版本.rar
hyiishzdscbb.description: 游戏内标题为"海洋II"（Ocean II），是 [hy2000](../hy2000/)/[hy2002](../hy2002/) 的另一个兄弟版本（约 9600/10253 个文件按路径与两者分别重合）——同一套 ES2/金庸题材代码血统的上海站第三次版本快照。
hyiishzdscbb.name: 海洋II上海站第三次版本 (hyiishzdscbb)
hyiishzdscbb.reason: 海洋II (Ocean II) lineage sibling of hy2000/hy2002 (~9600/10253 files shared by path with each) -- Shanghai station 3rd-version snapshot. Bugs fixed, all proactively applied from the known hy2000/hy2002 fix set and confirmed present: (1) stale MASTER_OB/SIMUL_EFUN_OB macros pointed at /adm/single/ dead-code duplicates (§7.56-class); (2) §7.54-class sscanf/write(read_file(missing_file)) crashes in howmany_visitor()/howmany_card()/uptime.lpc's LASTCRASH display; (3) §7.52-class socket gutting in adm/daemons/network/dns_master.lpc's startup_udp()/send_udp()/send_shutdown(); (4) classic §8.1 check_legal_name() byte-doubled bounds bug (2/10 -> 1/5 chars) plus the i%2==0 gate and name[i..<0] tail-slice (is_chinese() itself was already correct); (5) §7.63 quit.lpc's new('/clone/topten/magic-rice') missing the defensive if(ob=new(...)) guard, matching hy2000's exact pattern. ADMIN BOOTSTRAP DEVIATES FROM THE USUAL PATTERN (same §1.5 bug class as hy2002): securd.lpc hardcodes bootstrap admin id 'titny' directly in restore_list(), but that id is ALREADY an existing archived player account with an unknown password -- added a parallel set("wiz_status/fluffos","(admin)") line, registered fluffos/loginpass1, confirmed via visible 目前权限：(admin) display. Full registration->look->score->quit flow verified twice (before and after the LPC formatter pass) with a real Chinese name; both GB and BIG5 encoding confirmed working live (one benign compile warning in gb_b5d.lpc's Chinese-char conversion table, text renders correctly in both modes). Formatter run found 1 genuinely corrupted file (cmds/usr/setbak.lpc, same heredoc help-text corruption seen in hy2000/hy2002) -- reverted via git checkout.

hymud.description: 本游戏自称 **海洋V**，游戏内招牌名字为 **星月传奇**（登录后横幅显示〖海洋V-星月传奇〗）。属于经典的 "ES II" 引擎家族的 **海洋II** 一支的后续版本（与本项目中的 haiyang2/海洋II 同源，是它的独立演化版本）。本项目迄今处理过的最大一个压缩包（工作目录内约 5.7 万个源码文件）。
hymud.name: 海洋V·星月传奇
hymud.reason: derivative of haiyang2/海洋II, same codebase (confirmed by diff)

jh2006.description: 游戏内标题为"江湖2005"（Annihilator/书剑 ES2 血统），金庸题材mudlib。
jh2006.name: 江湖2006 (jh2006)
jh2006.reason: ES2/jinyong-lineage mudlib (Annihilator/ShuJian derived), in-game titled 江湖2005/江湖2006 (书剑, Book & Sword theme). Bugs fixed: (1) classic §7.59 this_player()-clobbers-root bug in adm/daemons/securityd.lpc's valid_read() -- crashed immediately at boot with *Read access denied. inside logind.lpc's gb_big5()'s very first BAN_D->is_banned() lazy compile, before the id prompt ever appeared; fixed by exempting func=="load_object"/"include" from the this_player() override, matching the established pattern exactly; (2) classic §8.1 GBK byte-range is_chinese() bug plus check_legal_name()'s byte-doubled bounds (4/8 chars, i%2 gate -> 2/4 chars) in adm/daemons/logind.lpc; (3) classic §8.3b dead command-table sscanf in adm/daemons/commandd.lpc's rehash() -- "%s.c$" matched nothing after the .lpc rename, leaving the ENTIRE command table empty; look/quit happened to still work (defined via add_action elsewhere or driver-handled), but every other command including the score-equivalent (stscore, not score -- this lib doesn't use the word "score") fell straight through to "什么？" until fixed. Admin (fluffos/Mud2026Pass) seeded via real registration + adm/etc/wizlist, confirmed via visible 您目前的权限：(admin) display (auto-moved to 巫师休息室). Full registration->look->stscore->quit flow verified twice (before and after the LPC formatter pass) with a real Chinese name -- note the registration flow order is id -> y/N confirm -> password -> confirm password -> Chinese name -> gift stats -> gender, not the more common id -> confirm -> Chinese name -> password order seen in other libs.

jhfy2.name: 江湖风云2 (jhfy2)
jhfy2.reason: Jinyong-themed mudlib, in-game titled 江湖风云II 之 辽宁风云再起 (Jianghu Fengyun II). Unusually clean: no mudlib code bugs found at all -- macros already matched config.fluffos, is_chinese()/check_legal_name() were already correctly codepoint-based, the command table worked out of the box, and no this_player()/previous_object() clobbering. Full registration->look->score->quit flow worked correctly on the very first real attempt. Only work needed was admin seeding: fluffos/loginpass1 added to the existing CRLF-formatted adm/etc/wizlist, confirmed via visible ★ 您目前权限：(admin) display. Full flow re-verified after the LPC formatter pass too. Formatter run found 2 genuinely corrupted files (d/huashan/map.lpc, an ASCII-art zone map with the same tokenizer-confusion pattern seen in sibling libs; d/player/fyue_room.lpc, a room description) -- both reverted via git checkout. d/city/sj.lpc has the same pre-existing, unreachable, missing-string-quotes corruption already documented for ffxymud's identical file path -- left unfixed, not a formatter artifact.

jhfy3.description: 游戏内标题为"夕阳再现 之「风云再起Ⅱ」"，是 [jhfy2](../jhfy2/) 的后续/扩展版本（7977/9332 个 jhfy2 文件按路径重合，jhfy3 在此基础上大幅扩充了内容），金庸题材 mudlib。虽然文件路径和 `jhfy2` 高度重合，但这份档案的 `d/city/sj.lpc`（"世界之巅"跳崖场景）实际上和 `jhfy2`所属的"天涯"家族版本不同，而是和 `xajh4gkb`（笑傲江湖4公开版，同样打着"夕阳再现"旗号）、`xyzx`（夕阳再现，同一品牌的源头版本之一）逐字节相同——说明"夕阳再现"是独立于"天涯"的另一个代码血统，这份档案是站在 `jhfy2` 的地图基础上、换用了"夕阳再现"这一支的核心系统文件。
jhfy3.name: 江湖风云3 (jhfy3)
jhfy3.reason: Jinyong-themed mudlib, sibling/successor of jhfy2 (7977/9332 of jhfy2's files shared by path, jhfy3 is a larger expanded superset), in-game titled 夕阳再现 之 「风云再起Ⅱ」. Only one bug: the §1.3e uptime()<30 startup-grace gate in adm/daemons/logind.lpc's logon() fired deterministically on every WASM connection (the harness connects instantly after boot, and no amount of real-wall-clock waiting via filler sends satisfies it since the WASM event backend is host-tick-driven, not wall-clock-driven) -- bypassed for loopback per the standing AGENTS.md §1.3e policy (query_ip_number(ob) != "127.0.0.1" && uptime() < 30). No Chinese-name/macro/command-table bugs found. Admin (fluffos, two-password scheme) seeded via real registration + adm/etc/wizlist (CRLF-formatted, matching the file's existing entries), confirmed via visible ★ 您目前权限：(admin) display. Full registration->look->score->quit flow verified twice (before and after the LPC formatter pass) with a real Chinese name -- note this lib uses a TWO-password flow (separate admin password then login password), unlike jhfy2's single password. Formatter run found 5 genuinely corrupted files (d/huashan/map.lpc and its u/fyue/ duplicate -- ASCII-art zone maps, same tokenizer-confusion pattern as sibling libs; d/player/fyue_room.lpc; d/quanzhen_old/hudi5.lpc, a pre-existing missing-string-quotes file like ffxymud's/jhfy2's d/city/sj.lpc; kungfu/skill/jinshe-jian/kuangwu.lpc, a two-line header comment merged with spacing inserted) -- all reverted via git checkout.

jianghufengyun.description: 本游戏自称 **江湖风云单机**。经过与本项目内另外两个同源作品（夕阳再现·疯狂江湖、未明空间）的核心文件比对，确认三者同出一脉，都源自"夕阳再现之江湖风云"这一支中文武侠 MUD 血脉——本作在三者中与共同祖先最接近，可以看作这一系列的核心版本。这一支和另一轮处理过的 `xyzx`/`jhfy3`/`xajh4gkb`/`xyzxyl201412` 是同一个真正的"夕阳再现"血统——注意本项目里还有另一批同样打着"夕阳再现"招牌、地图却是完全不同的"天涯"家族的档案（`xysylmhb`/`xyzxiiylzymh`/`yzxiiizylfy`/`xiyangzaixian3` 等），品牌名称不能作为判断血统的依据。
jianghufengyun.name: 江湖风云

jym.description: 以金庸小说世界观为背景的武侠 MUD。地图目录结构和 111`xkx2000zxb`（侠客行2000最新版，MudOS v22b25 世系）高度重合——`d/taihu/gumu/houtang.lpc` 等场景内容相同，只是文件头的"破解"署名不同（`xkx2000zxb` 是"Cracked by Kafei"，这份档案是"Cracked byRoath"），应是同一款"侠客行I"底层代码库的不同流通版本，此前两份档案都没有互相记录这层关系。`xkm`（侠客梦）也是同一批"Cracked byRoath"流通版本的手足档案。
jym.name: 金庸梦
jym.reason: finished an interrupted conversion (leftover static keywords across multiple files including master.lpc); reimplemented efun::tail() with read_file+explode+slice (§6.2); boots clean. Full WASM pass: added loopback-allow to band.lpc; fixed the same euid-reset-by-stray-seteuid(getuid()) bug in logind.lpc (create()/make_body()/howmany_user() all changed to seteuid(ROOT_UID)); fixed check_legal_name()'s stale GBK byte-length bounds and dropped a nonsensical name[j]+=128 mutation left over from a GBK high-bit assumption; guarded adm/daemons/securityd.lpc's get_status() against a not-yet-initialized wiz_status/wiz_levels reentrant-compile crash. Found two new bugs: cmds/usr/quit.lpc called environment(me)->query(...) unguarded, crashing *Bad argument 1 to call_other() whenever a player quits with a nil environment (guarded all three call sites); adm/simul_efun/message.lpc's tell_room(ob,str,exclude) wrapper passes the omitted varargs exclude straight to message()'s 4th argument as raw int 0 instead of an empty array -- crashes the FIRST tell_room() call in the game (the welcome room's own create()), a known shared-wrapper bug already cataloged as AGENTS.md §7.12, fixed with the documented `exclude || ({})` pattern. Admin seeded into data/securityd.o's wiz_status mapping (CRLF-paired encoding here, not the CR-only per-key encoding seen in the hy/hy5 lineage -- still edited with binary-mode file I/O for safety). Registration through world-entry, look/score/quit and admin recognition all cleanly verified with no residual banner-timing flakiness.

jyqxc.description: 游戏内标题为 "The Story of Hero"，金庸题材 mudlib。
jyqxc.name: 金庸群侠传 (jyqxc)
jyqxc.reason: Jinyong-themed mudlib (金庸群侠传), in-game titled 'The Story of Hero'. Two bugs fixed: feature/name.lpc's short() called capitalize(query("id")) unguarded -- crashes with 'Bad argument 1 to capitalize()' whenever an object reaches short() with no "id" property set, which happens for every one of this lib's ~49 bulletin-board clones because their data/board/*.o save files use a legacy compact binary encoding (magic bytes '#inh'/'?inh') that this driver's restore_object() can't parse; the resulting 'Illegal file format' failure zeroes the object's dbase mapping (including the "id" set moments earlier in create()) before throwing, so every look at a room containing a board crashed. Fixed by guarding short()'s fallback on stringp(id) instead of reformatting the ~49 legacy save files. Also seeded fluffos/Mud2026Adm as (admin) via adm/etc/wizlist. No Chinese-name/macro/command-table bugs found (is_chinese() already uses the correct Unicode codepoint range; check_legal_name()'s i%2==0 half-stepping under-validates non-Chinese characters at odd positions but never rejects a real Chinese name, so left as-is). Full registration->look->score->quit flow verified twice (before and after the LPC formatter pass); admin flow verified via the visible 目前权限：(admin) display. Formatter reverted 3 corrupted files, all ASCII-art zone maps (d/huashan/map.lpc, d/shaolin/npc/obj/map.lpc and its d/shaolin/obj/map.lpc duplicate) -- same tokenizer-confusion pattern as sibling libs in this lineage.

jyqxc2.description: [jyqxc](../jyqxc/) 的姊妹版本，同一套架构衍生的另一份存档（编号086/087），大部分文件内容不同，但整体结构和 bug 面几乎一致。
jyqxc2.name: 金庸群侠传 (jyqxc2)
jyqxc2.reason: Jinyong-themed mudlib (金庸群侠传), sibling codebase of jyqxc (86/87 numbering; not a file-identical duplicate -- most files differ, but shares the same architecture/bug surface). Same exact bug as jyqxc: feature/name.lpc's short() called capitalize(query("id")) unguarded, crashing on any object reaching short() without an "id" property -- hit by every one of this lib's ~18 bulletin-board clones because their data/board/*.o saves use the same legacy compact binary encoding (magic bytes '#inh'/'?inh') that restore_object() can't parse, zeroing the object's dbase mapping (including "id") before throwing. Fixed identically: guarded short()'s fallback on stringp(id). Seeded fluffos/Mud2026Adm as (admin) via adm/etc/wizlist. No Chinese-name/macro/command-table bugs (is_chinese() already codepoint-correct, commandd.lpc's sscanf already matches .lpc). Full registration->look->score->quit flow and admin flow verified before and after the LPC formatter pass. Formatter reverted 3 corrupted ASCII-art zone-map files (d/huashan/map.lpc, d/shaolin/obj/map.lpc, d/shaolin/npc/obj/map.lpc), byte-identical corruption pattern to jyqxc's.

jyqxc2013fwq.description: [jyqxc](../jyqxc/)/[jyqxc2](../jyqxc2/) 同一架构家族的另一份存档（2013 年服务器版），文件内容大部分不同，但整体结构和已知 bug 面基本一致。
jyqxc2013fwq.name: 金庸群侠传2013_服务器版 (jyqxc2013fwq)
jyqxc2013fwq.reason: Jinyong-themed mudlib (金庸群侠传2013_服务器版), sibling of jyqxc/jyqxc2 (same architecture family; not file-identical). Two bugs fixed, both in adm/daemons/combatd.lpc: (1) `#include </quest/quest.h>` used angle-bracket absolute-path syntax, which this driver resolves relative to the configured include directory (/include), not mudlib root -- every other absolute-path include in this codebase correctly uses quoted syntax (#include "/path.h"), so this one file's unique angle-bracket form failed with 'Cannot #include /quest/quest.h', which cascaded into 'Undefined function quest_finished' and left combatd.lpc uncompiled ('No program in object'), breaking score display for every player. Fixed by quoting the include. (2) Once the include resolved, quest.h's top-level `mapping quest_name = ([...]);` landed before combatd.lpc's `inherit F_DBASE;` (the #include was above the inherit line), which this driver disallows ('Illegal to inherit after defining global variables') -- fixed by moving the #include below the inherit statement. Also carried over jyqxc/jyqxc2's already-known short()/capitalize(query("id")) guard fix in feature/name.lpc (same legacy-binary-save-format board crash). Seeded fluffos/Mud2026Adm as (admin) via adm/etc/wizlist (note: original file had no trailing newline before the new entry -- added one to keep the two entries on separate lines). Full registration->look->score->quit and admin flow verified before and after the LPC formatter pass; formatter reverted 3 corrupted ASCII-art map files (same pattern as jyqxc/jyqxc2).

kuangxiangkongjian.description: 1995 年 9 月 22 日创建的老牌台湾 MUD（创始团队 wade、shorst、jcder等），属于 ES II 引擎系列（与本项目中的 es1_win、esI、xkx2001、rzrmud、侠客行系列等同宗）。本项目中还有另一个档案"新狂想空间II"（增加了邮箱注册等更新内容），两者虽然都自称"狂想空间"，但经比对是两个不同时期、独立流传的版本。本档案是相对更早的一个存档快照。
kuangxiangkongjian.name: 狂想空间
kuangxiangkongjian.reason: previously mis-flagged as a byte-identical duplicate of an orphaned archive filename that maps to no tracked lib; the content here is a fully independent, playable game in its own right (own -N variant number, own port, own README) -- duplicate_of cleared.

kxkjii2.description: ES II/Annihilator 系架构衍生的 mudlib，和 jyqxc 系列不是同一血统（存档用驱动原生的明文格式，不是那一系的旧式二进制格式）。
kxkjii2.name: 狂想空间II (kxkjii2)
kxkjii2.reason: ES II/Annihilator-derived mudlib (狂想空间II, 'Wild Imagination Space II'), distinct lineage from the jyqxc family (driver-native plaintext save format, not the legacy binary encoding). Two bugs fixed: (1) 358 files used AGENTS.md-§6.1-class angle-bracket absolute #include paths (e.g. #include </open/open.h>), which this driver resolves relative to the configured include directory rather than mudlib root -- too many scattered occurrences to hand-edit, so applied the documented bulk fix instead: added master.lpc's include_file(compiled, from, path) apply, prepending an extra '/' to force absolute-looking <> includes through the same merge()-based resolution quoted includes get. (2) adm/daemons/natured.lpc's check_heart_beat() had a stray semicolon terminating an if-condition early (`if (wizardp(...) && ...);`), making the following call_other() to a nonexistent daemon /adm/daemons/temp.lpc run unconditionally on every heartbeat tick (every second, forever) -- confirmed the file was never present anywhere in this codebase (a cut dev/debug scratch daemon whose two call sites were never cleaned up); removed both dead call sites rather than fabricate a replacement daemon. Registration uses a distinctive interactive point-buy flow (7 explicit stat prompts drawing from a shared 160-point pool, the 8th stat auto-filled from the remainder) instead of the jyqxc family's auto-generate-then-accept pattern. Admin level convention here is (manager), one tier above (admin) -- seeded fluffos as (manager) via adm/etc/wizlist to match the two pre-existing entries. Full registration->look->score->quit and admin flow verified before and after the LPC formatter pass; formatter reverted 6 genuinely corrupted files (stray '\ n' mis-tokenization inside Chinese-heavy string literals -- a new corruption shape not seen in the jyqxc family, distinct from that family's ASCII-art-map collapse pattern). Several very-large-diff files (thousands of lines removed) were verified as the formatter correctly stripping thousands of pre-existing trailing blank lines, not corruption.

ldtx.description: 源自 2026-07-29 批量归档 `mudlib.rar` 中的 `鹿鼎天下.rar`。"世纪(Century) / adm-single" 引擎家族的一支（与 `shiji`、`shujian2008`、`xianjianchuanqi`、`xiakexinzhuan2`、`xiakexing100` 同源），ES II 血统。
ldtx.name: 鹿鼎天下（游戏内实际品牌：雄霸天下『西安站』）
ldtx.reason: Century/adm-single family (shiji/shujian2008/xianjianchuanqi/xiakexinzhuan2/xiakexing100), in-game titled 雄霸天下『西安站』. WASM pass: gutted adm/daemons/network/dns_master.lpc's startup_udp()/send_udp()/socket_close() call in send_shutdown() (§7.52 socket-daemon gutting) -- socket_create()/socket_bind() are undefined efuns under this WASM build, and the resulting failed compile broke every call_other() into the file mid-function, including the encoding_to_mudlist() step that runs before the id prompt on every single connection. No Chinese-name/macro/command-table bugs (is_chinese() already codepoint-correct). Admin account 'fluffos'/'Mud@2026' was already seeded in adm/etc/wizlist from an earlier, pre-WASM pass over this lib (this lib already has a live deployment referenced in its README) -- verified the existing credentials still log in and show (admin) correctly, no new account needed (initially misread this as the §1.5 bootstrap-id-collision pattern and added a redundant parallel 'fladmin' account before noticing the lib's own pre-existing README already documented working fluffos credentials; reverted that addition). One pre-existing, non-blocking content gap left unfixed: d/city/npc/xiaobao.lpc's create() references a nonexistent /u/rhxlwd/cloth.lpc (a wizard directory that doesn't exist anywhere in this archive) -- call_other() on the resulting 0 throws 'Bad argument 1 to EFUN call_other()' but it's caught by the room's own setup()/reset() wrapper, so it never reaches the player; left as-is per the don't-fabricate-content precedent (same class as ffxymud/jhfy2/jhfy3's d/city/sj.lpc). Full registration (gb encoding select -> id -> confirm -> Chinese name -> password -> confirm -> gift select '0' -> accept 'y' -> email -> gender) and look->score->quit verified end-to-end before and after the LPC formatter pass; formatter introduced no corruption (all 3 blind-spot checks clean).

ldtxii.description: [ldtx](../ldtx/) 的姊妹版本（同一个 Century/adm-single 架构家族，但绝大多数内容不同，不是文件级重复）。
ldtxii.name: 鹿鼎天下II (ldtxii)
ldtxii.reason: Sibling of ldtx (same Century/adm-single family, same architecture, largely different content -- not a duplicate). WASM pass: fixed the classic §8.1 GBK byte-range bug in adm/simul_efun/chinese.lpc's is_chinese() (str[0] > 160 && str[0] < 255 -- a GBK leading-byte check that rejects every real Chinese character on this driver, since Chinese codepoints are 0x4e00-0x9fff, far above 255; replaced with the correct codepoint-range check). Also gutted adm/daemons/network/dns_master.lpc's startup_udp()/send_udp()/socket_close() (§7.52), identical fix to ldtx -- same undefined-socket-efun failure breaking the pre-id-prompt encoding_to_mudlist() step on every connection. check_legal_name()'s i%2==0 half-stepping is present but harmless (same as ldtx). Seeded fluffos/Mud2026Adm as (admin) via adm/etc/wizlist -- unlike ldtx, this lib had no pre-existing admin account or README from an earlier pass, so no id collision to work around. One pre-existing, non-blocking content gap left unfixed: d/city/chatroom.lpc's object list references /u/mouse/topten, a wizard directory that doesn't exist anywhere in this archive -- an NPC's heart_beat-driven random_move into this room hits make_inventory() calling new() on the missing file and crashing on the resulting 0->move(), same missing-content class as ldtx's xiaobao.lpc case (and the broader sj.lpc precedent); left as-is rather than fabricate a replacement. Full registration (gb -> id -> confirm -> Chinese name -> password -> confirm -> gift '0' -> accept 'y' -> email -> gender) and look->score->quit verified end-to-end before and after the LPC formatter pass; formatter introduced no corruption (all 3 blind-spot checks clean).

mnhf.reason: Campus-themed mudlib (模拟华附, set at 华南师范大学附属中学). WASM pass: fixed two bugs. (1) cmds/usr/uptime.lpc's write(read_file("/log/nosave/LASTCRASH")) (§7.54 class) -- the file doesn't exist on a fresh checkout, read_file() returns 0, and write(0) crashes with 'Bad argument 1 to receive()'; since UPTIME_CMD->main() runs during EVERY logon() before the id prompt, this crashed and disconnected every single connection attempt. Guarded with stringp(). (2) adm/daemons/httpd.lpc (§7.52) -- socket_create()/socket_bind()/socket_accept()/socket_write()/socket_close() are undefined efuns under this WASM build; the resulting failed compile ('No program in object') happened during preload, before the crashed-uptime bug even got a chance to matter. Since this daemon's entire purpose is serving HTTP over sockets, gutted setup()/write_data_retry()/store_client_info()/listen_callback()/close_connection()/remove() wholesale per the standing 'disable the whole file' guidance rather than patching individual call sites. No Chinese-name/macro/command-table bugs (is_chinese() already codepoint-correct). Seeded fluffos/Test1234 as (admin) via adm/etc/wizlist (this lib's check_legal_password requires 6+ chars with upper+lower+digit, so the usual Mud2026Adm-style password didn't satisfy the lowercase requirement -- used Test1234 to match this lib's own rule instead). Full registration (id -> confirm -> Chinese name direct entry -> password -> confirm -> email -> gender -> character-type 0-3) and look->score->quit verified end-to-end before and after the LPC formatter pass; formatter introduced no corruption (all 3 blind-spot checks clean).

njhhdxdes2hx.reason: ES2/xkx-derived campus build. WASM pass: fixed the §8.1 length-bound half and the leftover i%2==0 byte-stepping gate in check_legal_name() (is_chinese() itself was already codepoint-correct); fixed §7.47's origin()==ORIGIN_LOCAL/ORIGIN_CALL_OUT (int vs string) in feature/team.lpc; fixed §7.48's illegal private-across-files calls (treemap.lpc's _query/_set/_delete, action.lpc's continue_action, attack.lpc's attack -- private to protected); fixed §7.49's valid_write() save-extension mismatch causing quit to fail with Denied write permission. nt1.description: NT/nitan 系代码线（与 nitan170911/nitan6/hhsj 无精确 master-hash 匹配，独立代码线）。
nt1.name: 泥潭1
nt1.reason: NT/nitan lineage, no exact master-hash match to nitan170911/nitan6/hhsj; fixed a genuine content bug (accept_kill() in clone/user/user.lpc called is_killing(ob) instead of is_killing(ob->query("id")) -- is_killing() takes a string id everywhere else in the codebase); fixed efun::message() exc_target=0 rejection; boots clean. Full WASM pass: added loopback-allow to band.lpc's is_banned() (this lineage bans anything that doesn't parse as a strict 4-part dotted-quad, which would otherwise ban ::1/non-dotted addresses too); fixed is_chinese()'s stale GBK byte-range check; fixed check_legal_name()'s stale byte-length min bound and a second, separate 4-byte(=2-char)-assumption bug in named.lpc's invalid_new_name() (rejected any single-character given name as "empty", and a sliding-window near-duplicate-name detector stepping by raw byte offsets instead of characters); the same euid-reset-by-stray-seteuid(getuid()) bug in logind.lpc (create()/make_body()). The big one: adm/daemons/versiond.lpc (~2300 lines, a version-sync-and-checksum daemon with a TCP server/client bolted on) called socket_create/socket_bind/socket_listen/socket_accept/socket_address/socket_write/socket_close unconditionally across 13 separate functions, failing to compile the WHOLE FILE -- and logind.lpc's logon() calls VERSION_D->is_version_ok() unconditionally on every single connection, so the compile failure silently broke login for EVERY player, not just wizards. Per AGENTS.md §7.52's updated guidance, gutted only the socket-touching functions to no-ops (not the whole file, since is_release_server()/append_sn()/query() etc. are called from dozens of unrelated NPCs and commands elsewhere in the mudlib) -- this was the root cause of the connection hanging silently forever after the boot banner with no prompt and no error trace. Also found and fixed a genuinely broken/non-UTF8 directory and file names inherited from the original archive (20 entries under d/heimuya, d/jingzhou, d/tulong, d/beijing/map, and duplicated under a redundant work/version/ backup copy) that crashed the WASM test harness's Node-based directory scan outright (ENOENT on scandir) -- renamed to sanitized ASCII names, preserving content. Admin seeded via a code-level default in securityd.lpc's create() (wiz_status is declared nosave here -- never persisted to a save file at all, so there's no data file to edit; the seed must live in code) -- also had to mkdir -p a missing log/nosave/ directory that was silently aborting create() before reaching the seed line (restore()'s own log_file() call threw, uncaught within the object, only caught by master.lpc's outer preload() catch). New characters land in a /d/register/regroom.lpc requiring an in-game `register <email>` room-action before proceeding to the actual game world -- this and a per-second heartbeat-driven clock-redraw prompt made scripted post-registration command verification unreliable in the WASM test harness (same class of harmless timing artifact as nt6/nt6nitan6win); the core registration+world-entry+admin-recognition path is solidly verified regardless.

nt6.description: NT/nitan 血统 mudlib（与 nitan170911/nitan6 同源但非字节级相同），一个以创世神话（盘古开天、太极两仪）为背景的大型武侠 mudlib，共23000+ 个 `.lpc` 文件。
nt6.name: 泥潭6 (nt6)
nt6.reason: NT/nitan lineage but not byte-identical to nitan170911/nitan6. Prior WASM pass ported the §7.15 dbase-architecture fix comment/wizard.lpc pieces from nitan170911 and fixed several other bugs (GBK is_chinese(), origin() checks, band.lpc loopback, NTOS heartbeat removal, mudlistd.lpc sockets/array-type bugs) and got the lib to boot-clean, but left interactive registration unverified due to this lib's slow distributed preload (SYSTEM_D->valid_login() gates on a preload_list that drains one file per real second via call_out, ~30s total) repeatedly hitting test-harness timing issues. THIS pass finally completed registration verification and found the real remaining blockers were architectural, not timing: (1) the §7.15 port was incomplete -- feature/dbase.lpc's own comment already claimed set()/query()/delete() were 'now defined' as real per-object functions, but the actual function BODIES were never copied from nitan170911, so every F_DBASE-inheriting object's bare set()/query() calls still silently hit the simul_efun's single SHARED fallback dbase instead of their own -- ported the complete implementation (set/query/delete/set_temp/query_temp/delete_temp) from nitan170911's feature/dbase.lpc, this time verified against the actual file, not just the comment. (2) A second §8.1-class GBK byte-count-not-halved bug survived in logind.lpc's get_surname()/get_name() (check_legal_name(arg, 4) should be 2, matching the 'no more than 2 hanzi' prompt) and named.lpc's invalid_new_name() (strlen(name) < 2 should be < 1 -- rejected every legitimate single-character given name, e.g. '风', as 'empty name'). (3) 5 files (user.lpc, baby.lpc, giftd.lpc, examined.lpc, room.lpc) used `efun::set/query/addn/delete(...)` inside local property-accessor overrides to call the 'real' implementation, bypassing their own override -- but set/query/etc. were never genuine driver efuns on this build (only simul_efuns/inherited functions), so `efun::` failed to resolve at all ('Unknown efun'). Fixed by switching to `::` (parent-scope, resolves through F_DBASE now that it's complete) for set/query/delete, and to a direct `ob->add(prop,data)` call for the `addn` cases specifically (addn is simul_efun-only, never inherited, so `::addn` has no valid target -- two call sites had simply typo'd `addn` where the surrounding function was itself named `add()` and should have called `::add`, matching F_DBASE's real add()). Confirmed via a live WASM registration: full id->confirm->surname->name->admin-password->confirm->login-password->confirm->gender->email-registration flow completes with zero compile errors, look/quit verified (quit's new-account 30-min-retention deletion-confirmation flow also verified). A wizlist-listed admin id ('fluffos') was re-registered fresh and correctly routed to the wizard-only start room (巫师休息室), confirming admin status is honored. nte.description: ES2/Annihilator 系架构衍生的武侠 mudlib（"泥潭"系列的一支，和nt6/nitan 血统的 dbase 架构 bug 无关——这份档案自己的`feature/dbase.lpc` 本来就有完整的 `set`/`query`/`delete` 实现）。共 13000+ 个 `.lpc` 文件。
nte.name: 泥潭二 (nte)
nte.reason: 泥潭二 (Mud Swamp 2) -- an ES2/Annihilator-derived lineage distinct from nt6/nitan (own already-complete 2-arg set/query/delete architecture in feature/dbase.lpc, no §7.15 bug). WASM pass fixed: (1) classic §8.1 GBK byte-range is_chinese() (both the active and a dead-code-duplicate commented-out version used byte ranges; replaced the active one with the codepoint check) plus TWO independently-recurring instances of the unhalved-length-bound variant -- logind.lpc's check_legal_name(arg, 4) (should be 2, matching its own 'no more than 2 hanzi' prompt) at 2 call sites, its combined-name strlen(fname) < 4 (should be < 2), and named.lpc's invalid_new_name() strlen(name) < 2 (should be < 1, was rejecting every single-character given name as 'empty'). (2) §1.3e uptime()<30 gate in logind.lpc's logon() -- bypassed for loopback. (3) §7.52 socket-daemon gutting on TWO separate daemons: dns_master.lpc (small, single-purpose, gutted wholesale) and versiond.lpc (large multi-purpose release-sync daemon with 32 external callers of its non-socket functions like is_version_ok()/query() -- gutted only the 13 socket-touching functions/callbacks, left the rest of the public interface intact per the standing large-multi-purpose-daemon guidance). (4) §7.50 accept_kill()'s is_killing(ob) object/string mismatch in user.lpc (is_killing(ob->query("id"))), the same recurring copy-paste bug seen on nt1/wxddym/zjmudhell/hell. Seeded fluffos/AdminPass1+loginpw1 (two-password scheme) as admin via adm/etc/wizlist, confirmed routed to the wizard-only start room on registration. Full registration->look->quit (including quit's new-account deletion-confirmation) verified before and after the LPC formatter pass; formatter introduced no corruption (all 3 blind-spot checks clean -- the two large-diff outliers were versiond.lpc's own gutting and combatd.lpc's legitimate if-else-if damage-message-ladder collapsing, not corruption). Same in-universe 'not yet born until you complete a birth-ritual NPC dialogue' content gate as nt6/nt6nitan6win affects score for a freshly registered character -- not a bug, out of scope.

ntii.description: [nte](../nte/) 的同架构家族版本（ES2/Annihilator 系），本次修复涉及的档案（`logind.lpc`、`named.lpc`、`versiond.lpc`、`dns_master.lpc`、`clone/user/user.lpc`）和 nte 修复前逐字节相同——不是整个 lib 的重复（全库 10731/14000+ 个档案不同，主要是游戏内容），但这几个基础设施档案是共用的。

ntii.reason: 泥潭II (Mud Swamp II) -- same ES2/Annihilator architecture family as nte (泥潭二), and every file this pass touched (logind.lpc, named.lpc, versiond.lpc, dns_master.lpc, clone/user/user.lpc) was confirmed byte-identical to nte's pre-fix versions -- not a full-lib duplicate (10731 of ~14-16k files differ overall, mostly game content), but this specific set of infrastructure files is shared verbatim. Copied nte's already-verified fixed files directly rather than re-deriving the same patches: is_chinese() GBK byte-range fix, check_legal_name()'s unhalved length bounds (2 call sites + combined-name check) in logind.lpc, named.lpc's invalid_new_name() empty-name bound, the uptime()<30 loopback bypass, §7.52 socket-daemon gutting on both dns_master.lpc (wholesale) and versiond.lpc (selective -- 13 socket-touching functions gutted, ~32-caller non-socket public interface like is_version_ok()/query() left intact), and user.lpc's accept_kill() is_killing() object/string mismatch (§7.50). qhxajh.description: 和 019（xo，迷你版）、019-1（xo_final，最终版）同属 TMI-2/ES2/Falcon 系引擎家族，是清华大学版本的《笑傲江湖》，门派/剧情内容与前两者不同。
qhxajh.name: 清华笑傲江湖 (qhxajh)
qhxajh.reason: same XO/TMI-2/ES2/Falcon codebase family as 019 (xo) and 019-1 (xo_final), different quest/game content. WASM pass fixed: (1) classic §8.1 GBK byte-range is_chinese(). (2) logind.lpc check_legal_name()'s unhalved length bound ((< 4)||(> 10), matching a byte-count era, should be (< 2)||(> 5) to match its own 2-5-hanzi prompt). (3) a closure-form input_to((: get_id :), ob) that silently never fires under this driver, switched to the string form input_to("get_id", ob) like every other call site in the same file. (4) §7.52 socket-daemon: removed /secure/daemon/ftpd from secure/etc/preload (undefined socket efuns, 100+ call sites, no non-socket external callers, too large to gut individually). (5) §7.1 master.lpc valid_read()/valid_write() bootstrapping deadlock -- the documented crash-to-segfault form doesn't apply here (this build's driver degrades load_object() failure to a caught 'Object cannot be loaded during compilation' instead of crashing), so the bug surfaced as a SILENT one instead: securityd.lpc's own create() reading its wizlist via read_file() never completes because securityd.lpc itself can never finish compiling (every nested read the compiler needs for its own source/#includes/inherited files recurses back through valid_read(), each attempting load_object(SECURITY_D) again while still mid-compile) -- so wiz_status stays permanently empty and EVERY id, including ones already in the wizlist file, resolves to (player). A previous_object()==securityd-style special case does NOT fix this: during the nested compile-triggered reads previous_object() reports as master itself, never securityd. Fixed with the canonical §7.1 reentrancy flag (added to AGENTS.md as a new documented symptom of §7.1, since the existing writeup only covered the crash form). (6) missing libs/qhxajh/work/log/nosave directory (§7.11, gitignored, not tracked) was crashing log_login()'s log_file() call, breaking get_gender() silently for every registration. Also raised 'maximum evaluation cost' in config.fluffos from 700000 to 5000000000 (the tiny original cap was serializing preload into ~150 individually-interrupted resumptions, ~100s wall time; not itself a bug, just slow). Full registration (id->confirm->Chinese name->admin password->confirm->email->gender) -> enter world -> look -> score -> quit all verified working post-fix and post-formatter, admin id 'fluffos' correctly shows (admin). All 3 §9 formatter blind-spot checks clean (the flagged CJK-spaced strings were pre-existing author content, unchanged by the diff).

shujian3.name: 书剑3
shujian3.reason: extracted from a nested zip (the outer archive bundled an Android client apk + this shujian3.zip source drop); no master-hash match to bxsj/bxsj1 or any other lib; native boot was clean but the WASM pass needed real fixes: (1) logind.lpc euid resets (seteuid(getuid()) -> seteuid(ROOT_UID)) for create()/make_body(); (2) check_legal_name()'s stale GBK byte-length bounds and byte-stepping loop, plus is_chinese()'s GBK byte-range check, both fixed to per-character codepoint checks; (3) named.lpc's byte-stepping banned-name loop fixed to per-character; (4) band.lpc got the standard loopback-allow guard; (5) payd.lpc (HTTP payment-callback daemon) had 4 functions with unconditional socket_* calls (setup/store_client_info/listen_callback/close_connection) gutted to no-ops per the whole-file-entry-point-disabling approach; (6) a genuine, previously-undocumented securityd.lpc bug: valid_read() unconditionally overwrote the driver-supplied `user` argument with this_player(), which for "load_object"/"include" funcs is meant to be master_ob (root) -- clobbering it with the low-privilege connecting player denied compiling ANY code (including USER_OB and every #include) while a fresh/unprivileged account was connected, blocking registration outright; fixed by excluding those two funcs from the override; (7) a second genuine bug in commandd.lpc's rehash(): its sscanf pattern hardcoded the pre-conversion "%s.c$" suffix, which never matches this project's renamed "*.lpc" files, so get_dir()-filtered command lists came back empty and EVERY player command (look/score/quit/anything) silently fell through to the default "what?" fail message -- fixed to "%s.lpc$". Admin (fluffos/Mud@2026) seeded via a real registration + adm/etc/wizlist entry (plain-text wizlist mechanism, standard XKX/ES2-lineage securityd.lpc). Custom mobile-app protocol: `id,password,ciphertext,email` (comma auto-replaced with U+2551 ║) for login/register, then `gender║img║nickname` (literal ║ only) for character creation; an unconditional "ver1.0,<key>" + version-check banner prints at connect regardless of input.

sj.reason: "Zhanguo" (战国, Warring States) codebase, adm/obj/master.lpc lineage -- distinct from the sjecl/sje Century/adm-single family despite the similar slug. WASM pass fixed: (1) §7.60-class master.lpc log_error()/standard_trace() -> CHANNEL_D mid-compile crash, guarded both with find_object(CHANNEL_D). (2) §7.8/§7.9 case-sensitive+absent counter files: logind.lpc's VISITORS/GIFTCARD macros pointed at /adm/single/MUDVISITOR and /adm/single/GIFTCARD (uppercase) while the on-disk files are lowercase mudvisitor/giftcard -- crashed sscanf() on EVERY connection ('the user is disconnected', empty-looking transcript). Fixed the macros to match on-disk case and added stringp() guards on both read_file() results as defense in depth. (3) A missing `return` in logind.lpc's logon(): the '!find_object(DNS_MASTER)' branch (always taken here, since dns_master is disabled from preload per the standing no-sockets policy) already shows a simplified banner and prompts for id, but without a return the function fell through and unconditionally called DNS_MASTER->query_muds() right after, triggering the classic undefined-socket-efun compile error on every single connection. (4) §7.56 duplicate security-daemon files: SECURITY_D resolves to adm/daemons/securd.lpc (a save-file/dbase-backed daemon with a hardcoded bootstrap admin, 'keyboy' as (zhuguan)), NOT the similarly-named adm/daemons/securityd.lpc which is an unused decoy file sharing no code path with the macro -- initially seeded a text-format /adm/etc/wizlist entry that had zero effect since securd.lpc doesn't read that file at all; corrected by adding a parallel set("wiz_status/fluffos","(admin)") line in securd.lpc's restore_list(), matching its own existing keyboy bootstrap pattern (AGENTS.md §1.5's hardcoded-bootstrap-admin-id class). Verified: full registration -> look/score/quit all clean, permission display shows 〖银河特警〗(Admin) correctly, matching securd.lpc's own wiz_rank() display strings. One non-blocking, already-out-of-preload issue left as noise (matches §7.6's 'exclude from preload, guard the callers' -- callers already correctly guarded with find_object() checks everywhere except the one logon() call site fixed above; a couple of secondary DNS_MASTER call sites elsewhere still log the same compile-error text harmlessly when reached, not chased further). LPC formatter run across all 2697 files; reverted 8 files with confirmed CJK re-spacing corruption found via the same-text-despaced-matches-old-file scan across 30 formatter-touched files; also checked all map.lpc-shaped files present -- none were ASCII-art zone maps, all clean cosmetic reformatting. Post-formatter re-verified clean.

(2) §7.59 securityd.lpc valid_read() unconditional this_player() override denying load_object/include reads, excluded those two funcs. (3) §8.1 unhalved GBK byte-range is_chinese() + matching check_legal_name() length bound (4/8+i%2 window -> 2/4 per-codepoint). (4) §7.50 is_killing(who) object/string mismatch in the same 5 NPC dialogue files as sjecl (minus d/shaolin's, not present in this snapshot). New (not in sjecl): adm/daemons/backupd.lpc used an undefined BACKUP_DIR constant (preloaded, broke boot) -- added #define BACKUP_DIR "/backup/" to globals.h (a /backup directory already exists on disk, confirming the intended value). Also: adm/daemons/sited.lpc's is_valid() has a stricter/inverted rule than sjecl's -- ANY non-wizard id connecting from 127.0.0.1/localhost is unconditionally denied (only wiz_level(id) accounts may use loopback at all), so WASM testing (always 127.0.0.1) can only ever register wizard-status ids; worked around by seeding wizlist BEFORE testing and registering directly as fluffos (verifies admin and registration in one pass) rather than treating this as something to fix (a real security policy choice for this lineage, not a bug). Verified: full registration -> enter world, permission displays (admin) correctly. One non-blocking content bug logged, not fixed: adm/daemons/questd.lpc's spread_quest()/init_dynamic_quest() calls environment() on a 0 object during preload's dynamic-quest-placement pass (caught, doesn't block boot). LPC formatter run across all 8527 files; reverted 1 file with confirmed CJK re-spacing corruption (d/quanzhen/hudi5.lpc) found via the same-text-despaced-matches-old-file scan across 85 formatter-touched files; directly diff-reviewed both map.lpc ASCII-art files present (d/shaolin x2) -- clean, cosmetic only. sjecl.name: 书剑恩仇录 (sjecl)
sjecl.reason: Century/adm-single lineage (adm/single/master.lpc + adm/daemons/securityd.lpc), ShuJian/书剑 codebase. WASM pass fixed: (1) §7.60 master.lpc log_error() -> CHANNEL_D->do_channel() mid-compile crash, guarded with find_object(CHANNEL_D); same pattern also present in standard_trace() (the runtime error_handler path, not just compile warnings), guarded identically. tybxjh.description: 天涯泥潭（Tianya MUD Wizard Group）的"碧血江湖"档案，自 2002 年建站运行至今的老牌武侠 MUD。这份档案在 WASM 下**完全无需修复**——没有编译错误，没有执行时段错误，整个登录/注册流程一次跑通。同一个"天涯"代码家族还有 `wlhd`（武林浩荡/金庸梦II，`master.lpc`/`securityd.lpc`/`logind.lpc` 核心系统档案结构几乎一致，但地图内容各自独立修改过）、`xhcii`（笑红尘Ⅱ）、`zxty`（再现天涯）、`ffxymud`（非凡夕阳MUD/时空游侠录）、`jhfy2`（江湖风云2）、`xysylmhb`（夕阳三-炎龙美化版）、`xyzxiiylzymh`（夕阳再现II-炎龙专用美化客户端）和 `yzxiiizylfy`（夕阳再现III之炎龙封印）——后三者标题都带"夕阳再现"但地图其实是这个家族（真正的"夕阳再现"血统是`xyzx`/`jhfy3`/`xajh4gkb`/`xyzxyl201412` 那一支完全不同的代码）。除 `wlhd`/`yxjh` 外，这七者的 `d/city/sj.lpc`（"世界之巅"跳崖场景）逐字节完全相同；`wlhd`/`yxjh` 用的是 `wlhd` 独立改写过的"jump"版本，`ffxymud`/`xysylmhb`/`xyzxiiylzymh`/`yzxiiizylfy` 连登入横幅/标题都完全不像同一批档案，如果不比对源码很难发现它们同源。
tybxjh.name: 天涯之碧血江湖 (tybxjh)
tybxjh.reason: 天涯之碧血江湖 (Tianya "Bixue Jianghu" edition, TIANYA.ZB), Tianya MUD Wizard Group, live since 2002. Boots and runs completely clean under WASM -- no compile errors, no runtime errors, no fixes needed anywhere in the codebase. Only action taken: seeded fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist (SECURITY_D correctly points at /adm/daemons/securityd, confirmed via globals.h; a decoy copy exists at u/zjb/securityd.lpc but is not wired up). Note securityd.lpc's get_status() hardcodes 4 named euids (daniel/zjb/kjh/jiji) to always return the top (boss) tier regardless of wizlist contents -- this is intentional founder-account logic, not a bug, and doesn't interact with the fluffos account. Registration flow verified end-to-end in one continuous WASM client session: English id -> y/n create-confirm -> Chinese name -> admin password + confirm -> regular password (must differ) + confirm -> gift-stat selection (0 for random, y to accept) -> email (requires id@address format) -> gender -> enters world with a full character sheet, zero unexpected errors. Admin permission directly confirmed via the post-login banner '您目前权限：(admin)'. Testing note: this lib enforces a genuine 150-second LOGIN_TIMEOUT (call_out from connect, not per-prompt) that disconnects slow registrations with '您花在连线进入手续的时间太久了' -- this is real, intentional mudlib behavior (not a WASM/test artifact), confirmed by reading clone/user/login.lpc's time_out()/LOGIN_TIMEOUT (150s, include/login.h). Early test runs with a generous --idle (6-15s) to dodge compile-warning-flood timing races instead tripped this timeout, since get_email()/get_gender() trigger heavy one-time compilation of /inherit/char/char and its features; switching to a fast --idle 2 completed registration well inside the window and is the correct approach for this lib specifically. LPC formatter run across all 9398 .lpc files (9303 written, 61 errors on messy legacy code including one confirmed pre-existing token-mismatch skip, 34 unchanged); reverted 1 file (d/city/sj.lpc) with confirmed pre-existing (author-side, predates this pass) missing-quote corruption re-spaced further by the formatter. No :: parent-call split hits. No case-label-with-trailing-comment candidates found. Diff-reviewed all 4 map.lpc files -- 3 are brace-placement-only (K&R merge); cmds/std/map.lpc's diff initially looked larger due to a long sprintf() call being re-wrapped across multiple lines, but a full-file whitespace-normalized comparison confirmed byte-for-byte content equivalence (2032 chars, identical). Post-formatter re-verified with the same full registration flow -- clean, admin permission still (admin).
