wdxtym.description: 这份档案对应一次原本超时中断的转档（46890 个文件的大档案）。它用的是一套**自定义客户端协议**，不是普通的逐行提示：服务器一连线就送出一行版本挑战 `ver1.0,<crypt-salt>`，客户端必须回传正确加密后的应答，或者两个内建的绕过字符串之一（测试用 `123456789abcd` 即可），否则直接显示"客户端非法"并断线。之后的账号注册/角色创建也是整行、用全角竖线 `║` 分隔多个字段一次送出（`账号║密码║密文║email`，角色创建则是 `性别║头像║昵称`），这是为配合专属 GUI 客户端设计的协议，不是 bug。
wdxtym.name: 武动仙途 (wdxtym)
wdxtym.reason: Finished an interrupted conversion (46890-file archive originally timed out mid-convert). Uses a custom client protocol (not plain telnet prompts): server sends a version-challenge line 'ver1.0,<crypt-salt>', client must reply with the correctly crypted response OR one of two literal bypass strings ('123456789abcd' works for testing) or the connection is rejected with '客户端非法'. Registration/login is then a single pipe-delimited line per step (id║password║ciphertext║email for the account, gender║avatar║nickname for the character), not per-field prompts -- a GUI-client-oriented design, not a bug. WASM pass fixed: (1) §7.52-class sockets-package dependency: payd.lpc's payment-callback HTTP listener called socket_create()/socket_bind()/socket_close()/socket_accept()/socket_address() directly with no availability guard, failing the whole file's compile under WASM (Undefined function). Per AGENTS.md §7.52, gutted only the socket-touching functions (setup(), store_client_info(), listen_callback(), close_connection()'s socket_close call) to no-ops, since do_get() -- the one function actually called externally by cmds/adm/paym2.lpc -- doesn't touch sockets and needed to keep working. (2) A genuine off-by-one bug in eventd.lpc's create(): event_name = map_array(event_name, (: $1[0..<3] :)) was meant to strip the 4-character '.lpc' extension off each filename but only dropped 2 characters (e.g. 'emei.lpc' -> 'emei.l'), breaking collect_all_event()'s call_other() to EVERY event file at boot ('*call_other() couldn't find object ...emei.l'), i.e. the entire in-game event system was silently non-functional. Fixed the slice to [0..<5] (drops the correct 4 characters, e.g. 'emei.lpc' -> 'emei'). (3) §8.1-class is_chinese() in adm/simul_efun/chinese.lpc: the old GBK-byte-pair check (strlen(str)%2 rejects odd-length strings, checks raw byte ranges 176-247/161-254) rejected valid odd-character-count Chinese names like '小浮侠' under this driver's UTF8-codepoint string indexing -- rewrote to a per-codepoint 0x4e00-0x9fff range check. Admin seeded: fluffos_1 (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist (accounts get an automatic '_1' suffix appended by get_user(); SECURITY_D correctly points at /adm/daemons/securityd, wiz_levels tops out at (admin)). Observed but NOT fixed -- a transient, self-healing 'Too deep recursion' at adm/single/master.lpc's valid_read()/compile_object() delegation to SECURITY_D, and a transient 'Bad argument 4 to EFUN message(), Got: int(0)' from bossdd.lpc's heart_beat()->shout() path: both trace back to a message()/shout() call chain that IS correctly guarded at the source level (message.lpc's message() wrapper has the standard if(!exclude) exclude=({}) guard, confirmed via live instrumentation that the guard fires correctly and converts int(0) to ({}) on every observed invocation) -- these errors appeared once in an early test run and did not reproduce across 4 subsequent identical registration runs; the driver's own call-depth guard and per-object heartbeat auto-disable catch them safely with zero effect on gameplay (registration and world-entry completed successfully both times they occurred). Likely a heartbeat-timing race specific to the very first object-compile burst of a fresh boot, not a fixable source-level bug. Registration verified end-to-end multiple times: version-challenge bypass -> id║password║x║email -> gender║avatar║name -> enters world with full custom-protocol status line. Admin permission directly confirmed via '目前权限：(admin)'. LPC formatter run across all 46890 .lpc files (46740 written, 117 errors on messy legacy code, 33 unchanged); the one file matching the CJK-respacing grep signature (d/yihua/hubian.lpc) was confirmed pre-existing (present in the pre-format blob too) and left alone; a diff-level scan for 3-consecutive-spaced-CJK sequences found 177 raw hits, all confirmed false positives (none had a despaced match unique to the old blob). No :: parent-call split hits, no case-label-with-trailing-comment candidates. All 4 map.lpc files confirmed content-identical (whitespace-only) to their pre-format blobs. Post-formatter re-verified with the same full registration flow -- clean, admin permission still (admin).

weimingkongjian.name: 未明空间 (Weiming Kongjian / "wmkj")
weimingkongjian.reason: own game on 夕阳再现-derived engine Status corrected from a stale 'limited' -- no caveat was ever documented in this lib's own README or group_note, and re-testing this pass found none: Admin login (fluffos/Mud@2026) works cleanly, rank confirmed ('您目前权限：(boss)'), enters starting zone, quits clean. xajdxyj.name: 西安交大西游记 (xajdxyj)
xajdxyj.reason: 神话世界·西游记 version 4.50, in-game branded 《欢乐园》("A Journey to the West"), Xi'an Jiaotong University BBS-affiliated MUD. xkm.description: 与 147/jym（金庸梦）同源代码线（同一套 `simul_efun` 组成），但注册流程有额外分支，不要假设两者的 `--send` 序列完全一致。
xkm.name: 侠客梦
xkm.reason: same jinyongmeng (jym, 147) lineage/simul_efun composition -- reimplemented efun::tail() the same way (§6.2); boots clean. Full WASM pass: added loopback-allow to band.lpc; fixed the same euid-reset-by-stray-seteuid(getuid()) bug in logind.lpc (create()/make_body()); fixed check_legal_name()'s stale GBK byte-length bounds (dropped the +=128 byte-mutation leftover, made is_chinese() enforcement per-character); guarded securityd.lpc's get_status() against the reentrant-compile crash; fixed quit.lpc's unguarded environment(me) crash; fixed message.lpc's tell_room() exc_target=0 crash (AGENTS.md §7.12). New bug not present in jym: get_id() unconditionally registered input_to("get_passwdd",...) for ANY wiz_level>0 id -- including a BRAND NEW account that has just been granted wizard status but has no save file yet (exactly the situation admin-seeding creates) -- without checking whether a save file exists and without returning, so the very next input got silently diverted into get_passwdd()'s password check against an unset password, always failing with "密码错误" and destructing the connection. Fixed by gating the early registration on file_size(save_file)>=0 (matching the later, correct check in the same function) and adding the missing return. This is a real bug in the archived source, not something the admin-seeding process introduced -- it would affect any real deployment that grants wizard status to a not-yet-registered id. Also found the registration flow includes an additional QQ-number prompt and a 玩家守则 (player rules) y/n confirmation step not present in the jym sibling -- read the actual input_to() chain per AGENTS.md §8.2 rather than assuming jym's exact send sequence carries over.

xkx100.description: Coollizard & xkx100，2003-2004，yoyo.xm.fj.cn/xkx100。这份档案与另外单独完成的 GitHub `fluffos/xkx100` 仓库是完全不同的代码库，只是恰好同名。
xkx100.name: 侠客行一百 (xkx100)
xkx100.reason: 侠客行一百 (Coollizard & xkx100, 2003-2004, yoyo.xm.fj.cn/xkx100). Distinct from the separately-completed GitHub fluffos/xkx100 repo (different codebase, unrelated). WASM pass fixed 6 distinct compile/runtime bugs: (1) §7.48-class 'private' function called from an inheriting file: feature/treemap.lpc's _set()/_query()/_delete() were private, but feature/dbase.lpc (which inherits F_TREEMAP) calls them directly -- changed to protected, exact match to AGENTS.md's documented pattern. (2) The SAME §7.48 pattern independently in feature/action.lpc's continue_action() and feature/attack.lpc's attack(), both called from /inherit/char/char.lpc -- also changed private to protected. (3) §7.47-class origin()==ORIGIN_X int-bitmask comparison in feature/team.lpc's follow_path() (this driver's origin() returns a string) -- fixed to origin()=="local"/"internal" per the documented mapping. (4) A genuine missing-file robustness bug in adm/daemons/logind.lpc: howmany_visitor()/howmany_card() called sscanf() on the result of read_file() without checking it was a string first -- log/MUDVISITOR genuinely does not exist anywhere in this archive (confirmed absent even in raw/), so a truly fresh install hits this on the very first connection, before the id prompt even appears (the sscanf(0, ...) type-mismatch error is swallowed silently by the driver mid-logon(), hanging the connection with no error text and no prompt) -- added stringp(content) guards returning 0 on a missing file, matching the case this lib's own code clearly anticipated (num defaults to 0) but didn't implement safely. (5) A bad #include path in adm/daemons/combatd.lpc: '#include </quest/quest.h>' (absolute path syntax) doesn't resolve under this driver's include-directory search rules (config.fluffos sets 'include directories : /include'); every other active file needing the same quest_finished()/quest_failed()/lock_quest() helpers already uses '#include <quest.h>' (which resolves to /include/quest.h, a near-identical newer copy) -- switched combatd.lpc to match. (6) A knock-on 'Illegal to inherit after defining global variables' once fix 5 let the header actually load: quest.h declares a global quest_name mapping, which landed before combatd.lpc's 'inherit F_DBASE;' line -- moved the #include after the inherit statement (the safest place, since #include is pure text substitution and the inherit-then-globals ordering rule just needed satisfying). §8.1-class is_chinese() in adm/simul_efun/chinese.lpc was already a correct per-codepoint check; only check_legal_name()'s OWN separate i%2 gate and byte-count length bound (4-10, meant to be 2-5 characters) needed the same standard fix (per-character is_chinese(name[i..i]), length bound corrected to 2-5). Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist (multiple existing (admin)/(arch)/(wizard) accounts; SECURITY_D correctly points at /adm/daemons/securityd). Registration flow verified end-to-end in one continuous WASM client session: English id -> y/n create-confirm -> Chinese name -> password + confirm -> birthplace selection (1-5) -> stat-point allocation (3 explicit inputs, 4th stat auto-computed as the remainder) -> y to accept -> personality-trait menu (0 for none) -> email (id@address format) -> gender (m/f) -> enters world with a full character sheet and working 'score'/'look' commands, zero unexpected errors. Admin permission directly confirmed via 'wizlist' command output showing '目前权限：(admin)' with fluffos listed among the top (admin) tier. LPC formatter run across all 14255 .lpc files (14237 written, 2 errors, 16 unchanged). No :: parent-call split hits, no CJK-respacing hits, no case-label-with-trailing-comment candidates. All 8 map.lpc files confirmed content-identical (whitespace-only) to their pre-format blobs. Post-formatter re-verified with the same full registration flow -- clean, admin permission still (admin).

xkx2000zxb.description: 侠客行Ⅰ（"The Quest of Oriental Chivalry"），XiaKeXing GamingGroup 1996-1999，MudOS v22b25 世系，由 sdong 移植。`jym`（金庸梦）共享同一套地图骨架（`d/taihu/gumu/houtang.lpc` 等场景内容相同，只是文件头"破解"署名不同：这份是"Cracked by Kafei"，`jym`/`xkm`都是"Cracked by Roath"），应是同一款底层代码库的不同流通版本。
xkx2000zxb.name: 侠客行2000最新版 (xkx2000zxb)
xkx2000zxb.reason: 侠客行I ("The Quest of Oriental Chivalry"), XiaKeXing Gaming Group 1996-1999, MudOS v22b25 lineage, ported by sdong. WASM pass fixed: (1) §7.52-class from-scratch HTTP server: adm/daemons/network/http.lpc (the classic Truilkan/Jacques Interstice httpd.c, same lineage AGENTS.md already documents for mnhf) calls socket_create()/socket_bind()/socket_close() directly with no availability guard, failing the whole daemon's compile under WASM. No other file calls into this daemon (grepped, zero external callers), so per §7.52's default, gutted every socket-touching function (setup(), write_data_retry(), store_client_info(), listen_callback(), close_connection()'s socket_close call) to no-ops rather than patching call sites individually. (2) §8.1-class check_legal_name() bug in adm/daemons/logind.lpc: byte-count length bound (2-8, meant to be 1-4 characters) plus an i%2 parity gate PLUS a destructive 'fixup' hack (name[j]+=128 on any character the (already-disabled, commented-out) is_chinese check flagged) that would have corrupted valid names under UTF8 codepoint indexing -- rewrote the length bound to character count (1-4) and removed the +=128 mutation entirely (the underlying is_chinese-based rejection was already commented out by the original author, so this only removes the leftover corrupting side effect, not any active validation). adm/simul_efun/chinese.lpc's is_chinese() was already a correct per-codepoint check. Admin seeded via securityd.lpc's actual persisted save file (data/securityd.o, a plain-text saved-mapping literal, NOT the vestigial adm/etc/wizlist.h/wizlist text files which are read nowhere in the active codebase) -- added fluffos to both wiz_status ('(admin)') and wiz_sites ('.*', unrestricted, matching the existing 'npc' bootstrap entry's pattern) since logind.lpc's get_id() calls SECURITY_D->valid_wiz_login() for any wizard-level id and rejects logins whose euid has no wiz_sites entry at all, regardless of get_status() tier -- the existing waiwai/xgslxz admin accounts are IP-locked to 192.168.0.40 specifically, which would have blocked WASM-test/127.0.0.1 logins if copied verbatim. Registration flow verified end-to-end in one continuous WASM client session: GB/BIG5 encoding select -> English id -> y/n create-confirm -> Chinese name -> password + confirm -> gift-stat accept (y) -> email (id@address format) -> gender (m/f) -> enters world with a full character sheet and working score/look commands, zero unexpected errors. Admin permission directly confirmed via 'wizlist' command output showing '目前权限：(admin)' with no site-check rejection. LPC formatter run across all 8096 .lpc files (8021 written, 24 errors on messy legacy code, 51 unchanged); reverted 1 file (d/taihu/gumu/houtang.lpc) with confirmed pre-existing (author-side, predates this pass) unterminated-string corruption in its item_desc mapping (missing closing quotes around two 'hua1'/'hua2' entries) that the formatter's tokenizer re-spaced further. No :: parent-call split hits, no case-label-with-trailing-comment candidates. All 7 map.lpc files confirmed content-identical (whitespace-only) to their pre-format blobs. Post-formatter re-verified with the same full registration flow -- clean, admin permission still (admin), no site-check rejection.

xkx2017.description: 侠客行（"The Story of Hero"），MudOS v21 世系——和 110 `xkx100`、111 `xkx2000zxb` 是同一核心代码库家族（`combatd.lpc`/`quest.h` 的结构一眼就能看出来）。
xkx2017.name: 侠客行2017 (xkx2017)
xkx2017.reason: 侠客行 ("The Story of Hero"), MudOS v21 lineage -- same core codebase family as 110 xkx100 and 111 xkx2000zxb (visible in the shared combatd.lpc/quest.h structure). WASM pass fixed: (1) the identical bad-#include bug already seen on xkx2000zxb: adm/daemons/combatd.lpc's '#include </quest/quest.h>' (absolute-path syntax) doesn't resolve under this driver's include-directory rules -- switched to '#include <quest.h>' and moved it after 'inherit F_DBASE;' to satisfy the resulting global-variable-before-inherit ordering rule (identical fix, applied independently since these are separate archives). Wrapped bboard.lpc's restore() call in catch() (a shared inherit, so this protects every board clone in the mudlib, not just kedian_b's) -- the old board messages for that one corrupted board are unrecoverable, but the room/board object itself now initializes cleanly. No is_chinese()/check_legal_name() bug found -- 小浮侠 (3 characters) was accepted on the first attempt with no fix needed. Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist (this lib's securityd.lpc genuinely reads WIZLIST at boot, unlike xkx2000zxb's save-file-based mechanism -- confirmed via source before assuming the text-file approach would work; no site-lock gate like xkx2000zxb's valid_wiz_login() either). Registration flow verified end-to-end in one continuous WASM client session: English id -> y/n create-confirm -> Chinese name -> password + confirm -> gift-stat accept (y) -> email (id@address format) -> gender (m/f) -> enters world with a full character sheet and working score/look commands (including the previously-crashing board room), zero unexpected errors. Admin permission directly confirmed via 'wizlist' command output showing '目前权限：(admin)'. LPC formatter run across all 3268 .lpc files (3239 written, 29 errors on messy legacy code, 0 unchanged). No :: parent-call split hits, no CJK-respacing hits, no case-label-with-trailing-comment candidates. All 3 map.lpc files confirmed content-identical (whitespace-only) to their pre-format blobs. Post-formatter re-verified with the same full registration flow -- clean, admin permission still (admin).

xkxc98sj.name: 侠客新传98书剑 (xkxc98sj)
xkxc98sj.reason: 「侠客新传」v0.1b, MudOS v22pre11, Xkxz MUD Wizard Group 2000-2001, maintained by jjgod. WASM pass fixed 5 distinct bugs: (1) the same eventd.lpc off-by-one already fixed on wdxtym: event_name = map_array(event_name, (: $1[0..<3] :)) only stripped 2 characters trying to remove the 4-character '.lpc' suffix ('emei.lpc' -> 'emei.l'), breaking collect_all_event()'s call_other() to every event file -- fixed to [0..<5]. (2) §8.1-class check_legal_name()/is_chinese() GBK-byte-range bugs in adm/simul_efun/chinese.lpc (checked only the first 2 raw bytes against a fixed byte range, always failing under UTF8 codepoint indexing) and adm/daemons/logind.lpc's own length bound (min 2 / max passed as 8, meant to be min 1 / max 4 per the registration prompt text '名字的长度不能大于四个汉字') -- rewrote is_chinese() to a per-codepoint loop and fixed both the length bound and the check_legal_name(arg, 8) call site to 4. (3) A systemic is_killing(object) vs is_killing(string) type mismatch across 18 files (feature/attack.lpc declares is_killing(string id), but many call sites across kungfu skills and city NPCs passed the object directly: is_killing(me)/is_killing(who)/is_killing(ob)/is_killing(ob[i])) -- the exact same bug class already fixed on sjecl/sje earlier in this pass, here far more widespread; fixed every active call site to pass ->query('id') (2 already-commented-out call sites in haotian-zhang/ju.lpc and quanzhen-jianfa/ding.lpc left untouched, since they're dead code). (4)+(5) §7.41-class corrupted-save bugs: adm/daemons/emoted.lpc's create() called restore() unguarded on a genuinely corrupted emote.o ('Illegal mapping format'), and adm/daemons/newsd.lpc's create() had the identical unguarded restore() on a corrupted dbase save -- both wrapped in catch() so the exception no longer aborts create() before reaching (or in emoted's case, entirely skips) the empty-mapping fallback; confirmed via the driver's own error trace that both are now caught locally (CATCH() frame inside the daemon's own create()) rather than propagating to a distant outer catch, with zero further errors downstream. Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist (SECURITY_D genuinely reads WIZLIST at boot, confirmed via source). Registration flow verified end-to-end in one continuous WASM client session: BIG5/GB prompt -> English id -> y/n create-confirm -> password + confirm -> Chinese name -> character-type selection (1-5) -> gender (m/f) -> enters world with a working score/look and no lingering runtime errors. Admin permission directly confirmed via '您目前的权限是：(admin)'. LPC formatter run across all 6905 .lpc files (6829 written, 44 errors on messy legacy code, 32 unchanged). No :: parent-call split hits, no CJK-respacing hits, no case-label-with-trailing-comment candidates. All 3 map.lpc files confirmed content-identical (whitespace-only) to their pre-format blobs. Post-formatter re-verified with the same full registration flow -- clean, admin permission still (admin), no restore errors beyond the two already-caught/documented ones.

xkxlb.archive: 侠客行老版(金庸群侠传）.rar
xkxlb.description: 从一个扩展名错误的 `.rar`（实际是带有 `../` 成员路径的 POSIX tar）提取。归档里还带着一份未被使用的 `adm/obj/master.lpc`，恰好和jyqxc/fy2mg/xkx2017 那套框架字节相同——但实际启动用的是`/adm/single/master`，不是这份。
xkxlb.name: 侠客行（老版/金庸群侠传）
xkxlb.reason: extracted from a mis-extensioned .rar that was actually a POSIX tar with ../ member paths; boots via /adm/single/master (an unused adm/obj/master.lpc bundled in the tree happens to byte-match the jyqxc/fy2mg/xkx2017 framework family, but isn't the one actually loaded); boots clean with zero fixes needed. Full WASM pass: added loopback-allow to band.lpc; fixed the euid-reset-by-stray-seteuid(getuid()) bug in logind.lpc's make_body(); fixed check_legal_name()'s stale GBK byte-length bounds; guarded securityd.lpc's get_status() defensively; fixed the classic §7.49 save_object-extension-mismatch bug in securityd.lpc's valid_write(). The big find: SIMUL_EFUN_OB in include/globals.h pointed at a stale, unused /adm/single/simul_efun.lpc (a dead-code duplicate from an earlier reorg, present in the tree but not referenced by config.fluffos's 'simulated efun file' setting) instead of the REAL /adm/obj/simul_efun.lpc that config.fluffos actually loads and that defines the destruct() override. This broke feature/move.lpc's remove() security check (which validates previous_object() against SIMUL_EFUN_OB) on every single object destruct routed through that override -- concretely, it broke `quit` for EVERY new player, since quit's auto-drop-inventory logic destructs any worthless dropped item (every fresh character starts with one). The bug was silent: the connection printed a caught runtime error and looked like it disconnected, but the character was actually still logged in and the world-side connection never actually closed. Fixed by pointing the macro at the real file (same instinct as the securityd.lpc/securd.lpc duplicate-file trap from an earlier lib -- always verify a path macro against config.fluffos/the actual call trace before trusting it, even for macros that look definitively canonical). Also fixed a genuinely corrupted bulletin-board save (data/board/kedian_b.o had raw non-UTF-8 GBK bytes in a post's author field, crashing every `look` in that room) by removing the corrupted save file outright rather than attempting a risky partial byte-level re-encode. Admin seeded via the plain-text adm/etc/wizlist file. Registration through world-entry, look/score, and a CORRECTLY COMPLETING quit are all cleanly verified -- re-test quit specifically on any lib sharing this SIMUL_EFUN_OB/duplicate-simul_efun-file shape.

xkyxciii.name: 侠客英雄传III (xkyxciii)

xyj2000.reason: 西游记2000 (Journey to the West 2000), a classic MudOS-era mudlib themed around Journey to the West, with an in-flow 'are you a school-age student' age-gate question that's original design, not a bug. WASM pass fixed 3 chained bugs: (1) adm/daemons/convertd.lpc's GB/BIG5 conversion table (inittable) had the same byte-level corruption pattern as the sjsh-family libs (symbols packed together instead of one per array element) -- fixed with the standard per-codepoint resplitting script (~45 lines affected). (2) adm/daemons/network/dns_master.lpc, a genuinely multi-purpose intermud daemon (query_mud_name()/muds mapping called by ~28 other service files: mudlist_a/mudlist_q/gtell/gchannel/rwho/etc) -- per AGENTS.md §7.52's exception for multi-purpose daemons, did NOT disable the whole file; only gutted the two socket-touching entry points (startup_udp() now returns 0, matching its own existing failure-return convention so create()'s 'if (startup_udp()) init_database();' naturally skips socket-dependent init; send_udp() now a no-op) plus removed one straggling socket_close() in send_shutdown(). (3) A chained bug this exposed: adm/etc/preload had the dns_master line commented out (enabled in the original raw archive; likely someone's pre-existing workaround to let the mudlib boot at all before the socket-compat fix existed), so DNS_MASTER was never preloaded. adm/daemons/logind.lpc's encoding() checks 'if(!find_object(DNS_MASTER) || ...) shutdown(1);' right after encoding selection -- find_object() only returns true for already-loaded objects, so with the daemon never preloaded this check was always true, and shutdown(1) fired on literally every connection immediately after GB/BIG5 selection, leaving the connection with no further input_to() registered (all subsequent input showed as unrecognized commands). Root-caused via reading logind.lpc's encoding() and confirming the preload line was disabled while the raw archive had it active; fixed by re-enabling the preload line now that dns_master.lpc compiles and runs cleanly under WASM -- no change needed to logind.lpc's own check. Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist (securityd.lpc genuinely reads WIZLIST at boot). Registration flow verified end-to-end in one continuous WASM client session: GB/BIG5 select -> no (age gate) -> new -> English id -> Chinese name -> password + confirm -> email -> gender (m/f) -> stat-allocation menu (9 to accept defaults, y to confirm) -> enters world with full character sheet; look/score/quit all clean. Admin permission directly confirmed via '目前权限：(admin)' on login. LPC formatter run across all 5637 .lpc files (5542 written, 4 refused as pre-existing unterminated-string/textblock content bugs unrelated to formatting, 91 unchanged). No :: parent-call split hits, no CJK-respacing hits, no case-label-with-trailing-comment candidates in the pre-format blobs of changed files. RETROACTIVE follow-up after scripts/scan_known_bugs.py (a new static scanner built this session) flagged 5 lazy-loaded/latent bugs the original registration-only smoke test never triggered: d/obj/books-nonskill/book-qujing.lpc's absolute #include </d/qujing/obstacle.h> (never resolves, quoted instead); logind.lpc's check_legal_name() had the standard §8.1 i%2 parity gate + [i..<0] suffix slice (harmless here only because this lib's is_chinese() happens to just check str[0], but fixed to the standard per-codepoint form for consistency/robustness); master.lpc's valid_read()/valid_write() forwarded straight to SECURITY_D with no 'user == this_object()' guard (the same latent risk that silently killed every new-player-body compile on sibling xyj20032 -- not observed to fire here, fixed proactively); 3 files called is_killing(me) with an object where feature/attack.lpc declares is_killing(string id) (§7.50, daemon/class/dragon/dragonforce/roar.lpc, daemon/class/yaomo/kusong/huomo/fire.lpc, cmds/std/surrender.lpc); d/sky/npc/zz-tianwang.lpc still had raw GBK bytes the original conversion pass missed (iconv'd). Also found and fixed adm/simul_efun/message.lpc's tell_room() forwarding an unset exclude straight into message()'s 4th arg (§7.12, exclude || ({})). Re-verified clean post-fix.

xyj20032.description: 档案名叫"西游记2003-2"，但游戏本身开机后自报家门是**三界神话（SanJieMyth）「测试二区」**——和 059 `sanjiechuanshuo`、060 `sanjieshenhua`是同一套"三界"代码库家族的另一个成员（`get_gender()`/`enter_world()`/`make_body()` 等核心函式和 `sanjieshenhua` 逐字比对完全一致），开机横幅还留着一段"西游记之新纪元"的 ASCII 字画，应该是更早一次改名留下的痕迹。
xyj20032.name: 西游记2003-2 (xyj20032)
xyj20032.reason: Archived as '西游记2003-2' but the live game identifies itself as 三界神话 (SanJie Myth) 「测试二区」 -- another member of the same 三界 codebase family as 059 sanjiechuanshuo and 060 sanjieshenhua (identical get_gender()/enter_world()/make_body() bodies confirmed via direct diff against sanjieshenhua), with a vestigial Xi You Ji-themed opening ASCII banner left over from an earlier rebrand. WASM pass fixed 4 bugs, the last two found only via targeted write()-instrumentation bisection since they failed completely silently (no error trace at all): (1) adm/simul_efun/message.lpc's message() simul_efun wrapper called efun::message() with a bare 3-arg exclude default of int 0 instead of an array, crashing on 'Bad argument 4 to EFUN message()' from multiple call sites (disasterd.lpc's announce() among them) -- classic AGENTS.md §7.61, fixed with 'exclude || ({})'. (2) adm/obj/master.lpc's log_error() unconditionally called CHANNEL_D->do_channel() for every compile warning including harmless ones, and since CHANNEL_D isn't preloaded yet during the very first files compiled at boot, that call-other recursively triggered a fresh compile mid-compile, crashing with 'Object cannot be loaded during compilation' and cascading into a wall of repeated trace dumps -- classic AGENTS.md §7.60, fixed by guarding with find_object(CHANNEL_D) first. (3) adm/daemons/channeld.lpc's do_channel() called environment(me)->query('no_chat') unguarded; log_error()'s CHANNEL_D broadcast (bug 2, before it was fixed) passes the master object itself as 'me', which has no environment, crashing on a 0 target -- fixed with 'environment(me) && environment(me)->query(...)'. (4) The deepest bug, found by bisecting get_gender()->make_body()->new(USER_OB) with write() instrumentation at each step: the driver's own load_object() security check (triggered internally by new() compiling the player-body class for the first time) calls master.lpc's valid_read() apply with the MASTER OBJECT ITSELF as the 'user' argument; master.lpc's valid_read() just forwarded straight to securityd.lpc's valid_read() with no special case for system-initiated loads, and geteuid(master_ob) resolves to a falsy euid there, so the path-permission logic denied the read (silently -- no error message anywhere, since the driver's 'Read access denied' just makes new() return 0, and make_body()'s own failure-path write() never fires because the write target, the not-yet-exec'd login object, produces a message that's easy to miss without direct instrumentation) -- every single new-player registration died silently at gender selection with zero visible symptoms beyond 什么？ echoing for all further input. Fixed by short-circuiting master.lpc's valid_read()/should be paired with a similar guard on valid_write() if that class of bug recurs: 'if (user == this_object()) return 1;' before delegating to SECURITY_D. Also fixed the standard §8.1 GBK-byte-range bug in both adm/daemons/chinesed.lpc's is_chinese() (byte-range/parity-based) and adm/daemons/logind.lpc's check_legal_name() (same parity assumption), rewritten to per-codepoint checks -- this is what caused '小浮侠' to fail Chinese-name validation before that fix. Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist (securityd.lpc genuinely reads WIZLIST at boot). Registration flow verified end-to-end across several WASM client sessions given a call_out(0)-driven post-registration gift-stat menu that races the test harness's idle-based send pacing (heavy first-time player-body compile burst, matching the session's established xhcii/xkyxciii/xsfyssjb WASM timing-race pattern, not a mudlib bug -- confirmed via a fully clean run reaching look/score with zero errors): GB/BIG5 select -> underage gate absent on this sibling -> new -> English id -> admin password + confirm -> regular password + confirm -> Chinese name -> email -> gender (m/f) -> stat-allocation menu (9 to accept defaults, y to confirm) -> enters world silently at /d/wiz/init -> live disaster-event channel broadcasts and autosave firing correctly (proving the message()/CHANNEL_D fixes hold under real gameplay) -> look/score both clean. LPC formatter run across all 12362 .lpc files (12194 written, 36 errors -- pre-existing unterminated-string/textblock content bugs unrelated to formatting, 132 unchanged). No :: parent-call split hits, no CJK-respacing hits; the case-label-with-trailing-comment blind spot found several matching lines (ftpd.lpc/natured.lpc/esman.lpc/vi.lpc) but diff-review confirmed the formatter preserved every following statement correctly (no swallowed code) on this run. RETROACTIVE follow-up: scripts/scan_known_bugs.py (new static scanner) flagged 15 is_killing(me) call sites (§7.50, feature/attack.lpc declares is_killing(string id)) across various kungfu-skill daemon/class/*.lpc files and cmds/std/surrender.lpc -- fixed to is_killing(me->query("id")); a 16th hit in daemon/class/pansi/chixin-jian/MIE.C was inside a // comment, left alone. The active adm/daemons/logind.lpc's check_legal_name()/master.lpc's valid_read() were already fixed in the original pass; only dead sibling copies in u/mudring/ and u/kuku/ still show the parity-gate pattern in the scan (never loaded via LOGIN_D, not fixed). Re-verified clean post-fix.

yhwhpublicfi.description: Doing 一脉的又一个分支（`master.lpc` 文件头注明"for ES II mudlib...updated by Doing Lu for hell (2K), modified by Linux@lxtx for yh2003.3"），游戏内标题为《武林群侠传》之炎黄武魂。注册流程采用姓+名分开输入，管理密码/登陆密码双密码制，角色创建时以 5 选 1 的角色类型菜单（猛士/智慧/耐力/敏捷/均衡）取代天赋随机菜单，且没有电子邮箱这一步。
yhwhpublicfi.name: 炎黄武魂public-final-2016-12-08 (yhwhpublicfi)
yhwhpublicfi.reason: 炎黄武魂public-final-2016-12-08 -- a Doing-lineage build (master.lpc's header credits 'ES II mudlib... updated by Doing Lu for hell (2K), modified by Linux@lxtx for yh 2003.3'), in-game titled《武林群侠传》之炎黄武魂. Surname+given-name registration (get_surname/get_name) with dual admin+login passwords, a 5-option character-type menu (猛士/智慧/耐力/敏捷/均衡) instead of a gift-stat roll, and no email step. WASM pass fixed: (1) classic §8.1 GBK byte-range is_chinese() (parity-gated 176-247/161-254 byte check) rewritten to a per-codepoint 0x4e00-0x9fff loop over every character (not just the first). (2) Three independent byte-doubled length-bound bugs from the same §8.1 lineage, all halved to match this driver's per-codepoint string indexing: check_legal_name()'s minimum bound (strlen<2 -> strlen<1) and its maxlen bound (maxlen -> maxlen/2), the combined surname+name minimum in get_name() (strlen(fname)<4 -> <2), and named.lpc's invalid_new_name() sliding-window near-name dedup checks (minimum 2->1, window slices name[i..i+3]/name[i..i+5] -> name[i..i+1]/name[i..i+2], loop bound l-4 -> l-2, gate i+6<=l -> i+3<=l) -- without these, a single-character surname like 张 was rejected as 'too long' and any two-character full name was rejected as 'too short'. (3) master.lpc's valid_read()/valid_write() (unusually at adm/single/master.lpc, not the typical adm/obj/master.lpc) were missing the standard 'user == this_object()' short-circuit before delegating to SECURITY_D -- added to both, fixing the silent new()-registration-hang failure mode. (4) versiond.lpc's in_server() called get_config(__MUD_PORT__) + VERSION_PORT expecting an int but the WASM driver's get_config(__MUD_PORT__) didn't resolve to the expected type here, producing a string-concatenated port ('12') and a 'Bad argument 2 to socket_bind()' crash at every boot; per AGENTS.md §7.52 (matching the hell/hell-family precedent for this same versiond.lpc lineage almost verbatim), gutted all 13 socket-touching functions (in_server, connect_server, clear_syn_info's socket_close loop, send_command, send_client_pending_msg, syn_finish's socket_close, in_listen_callback, in_write_callback, in_close_callback, cmd_close, send_pending_msg, send_result, remove_connection's socket_close) to no-ops/notify_fail, leaving the surrounding version-tracking logic (which doesn't touch sockets) intact. (5) §7.50 is_killing(object) vs is_killing(string id) type mismatch fixed across 15 call sites (kungfu/skill/*.lpc's 10 hits, clone/user/user.lpc, clone/lonely/sheying.lpc, d/city/npc/guidao.lpc, cmds/std/surrender.lpc, cmds/std/ansuan.lpc) via the standard ->query("id") wrapper. adm/daemons/ftpd.lpc and adm/daemons/network/dns_master.lpc are both dormant (commented out of adm/etc/preload, no runtime callers outside their own network/ subdir) and were left untouched. Admin seeded: wlqxztest (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist (wiz_levels tops out at (admin); wizlist lookup is by ID string alone, so admin status shows immediately on a freshly-registered character with no separate save/relogin step needed). Registration verified end-to-end multiple times: English id -> y (confirm new character) -> surname -> given name -> admin password + confirm -> login password + confirm -> character-type menu (1-5, used 5) -> gender (m/f) -> enters 世外桃源, full flow clean. Admin permission confirmed via '目前权限：(admin)'. score requiring a separate in-game '出生' step before it reports data is an intentional game-design gate, not a bug, and was left alone. LPC formatter run across all 10751 .lpc files (10715 written, 6 pre-existing errors on messy legacy code, 30 unchanged). No :: parent-call split hits, no case-label-with-trailing-comment candidates, no CJK-respacing/broken-escape hits. Post-formatter re-verified with the same full registration flow -- clean, admin permission still (admin).

yxjh.name: 浴血江湖 (yxjh)
yxjh.reason: 浴血江湖3梦回江湖. WASM pass found and fixed 5 genuine bugs: (1) the plain-named adm/etc/preload file was MISSING from the archive (only preload.bak and a slightly-shorter preloadbb variant existed) -- restored it from preload.bak (the more complete of the two), which also turned out to have CRLF line endings that update_file()'s explode(str,"\n") doesn't strip, so every preloaded daemon path was silently becoming e.g. '/adm/daemons/securityd\r.lpc' and failing file_size() -- converted to LF so preload actually works (previously ZERO daemons were being preloaded; logind.lpc only worked by accident via direct inheritance from clone/user/login.lpc). (2) Standard §8.1 GBK byte-range check_legal_name() (i%2==0 parity gate, name[i..<0] suffix slice, byte-doubled 2/10 bounds) in the one ACTIVE adm/daemons/logind.lpc, fixed to per-codepoint name[i..i] and 1/5 bounds; is_chinese() itself was already correct. Left three dead backup copies untouched (clone/user/logind.lpc sits alongside the real clone/user/login.lpc plus login_back.lpc/loginbak.lpc; u/rock/ is a wizard's personal full-mudlib backup directory with its own logind.lpc/master.lpc/user.lpc/etc.) -- neither LOGIN_D nor the master file config point at either, confirmed via master file/simulated efun file paths in config.fluffos. (3) master.lpc's valid_read()/valid_write() (the real adm/obj/master.lpc, not u/rock/obj/master.lpc's dead copy) were missing the standard 'user == this_object()' short-circuit -- added to both. (4) d/jerry/saveme.lpc's create() called exert_function(10) -- exert_function(string func) (defined in inherit/char/npc.lpc) takes a skill-name string, not an int, so this NPC failed to compile at all ('*No program in object'), breaking a chunk of a city room's population every boot; the call's intent is unrecoverable (dead code, not miskeyed arithmetic like other libs' fixes this session) so it was simply removed, matching how yhyxcs's earlier native-boot pass deleted an unrecoverable force-reload trick rather than guess at a fix. (5) 118 of 130 .o save files under data/ were CRLF, which the driver's restore_object() can choke on for nested-mapping structures -- normalized all to LF; this fixed most but not all restore issues (see below). Socket-touching adm/daemons/httpd.lpc and adm/daemons/network/dns_master.lpc are both absent from the (now-restored) preload list and have no real external callers -- left untouched, no §7.52 gutting needed. Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist (this lib's tier ladder tops out at (ceo) above (admin); used the project-standard (admin) tier for consistency, per this session's convention). Registration verified end-to-end pre- and post-formatter (English id -> y confirm -> Chinese name -> admin password + confirm -> login password + confirm -> gift-stat menu ('0' random -> 'y' accept) -> email -> gender -> enters 中央广场), admin permission confirmed via '◇ 您目前权限：(admin)'. Known NOT-fixed issue: adm/daemons/named.lpc's restore_object() still throws 'Illegal mapping format while restoring dbase' at every boot even after the CRLF fix -- the save file's mapping literal is syntactically balanced (verified bracket-matched) so the cause is something else in this driver's stricter restore_object() parser, not chased down further; the failure is caught (preload()'s catch()) and only degrades named.lpc's near-name-collision dedup checking, it does not block registration, world entry, or any other observed functionality -- logged per AGENTS.md §7.15's spirit, not blocking. LPC formatter run across all 13038 .lpc files (11874 written, 1119 pre-existing unterminated-string/textblock errors on this session's messiest codebase left unformatted, 45 unchanged). No :: parent-call split hits, no case-label-with-trailing-comment candidates, no CJK-respacing/broken-escape hits. Post-formatter re-verified with the same full registration+admin-login flow -- clean, admin permission still (admin).

yxsj.description: 《逸俠之世界》（Daniel's World），ES II 引擎家族，台灣出品（BBS140.127.179.161，聯絡信箱 leonguo@tpts4.seed.net.tw）。注册流程为英文 ID → 中文名字 → 密码 + 确认 → 电子邮件 → 性别。
yxsj.name: 逸俠世界 (yxsj)
yxsj.reason: 逸俠之世界 (Daniel's World), ES II lineage, Taiwan-origin (BBS 140.127.179.161, contact leonguo@tpts4.seed.net.tw). MAJOR encoding bug found and fixed before any WASM-specific work: this archive is BIG5-encoded, but the initial convert_lib.sh pass (which hard-codes GB18030 as the source encoding) round-tripped every string through the WRONG codepage -- the result was valid UTF-8 that decoded to real-but-nonsense CJK characters (e.g. write("\u7729\u7420\u3085") instead of "\u60a8\u7684\u82f1\u6587") rather than an iconv error, so it looked converted but every player-facing message was mojibake. Confirmed by decoding a raw .c file with both codecs and comparing a write() string literal. Extended scripts/convert_lib.sh with an optional third 'source-encoding' argument (defaults to GB18030, unchanged for every other lib) and re-ran this lib's conversion with BIG5 -- all prior source-level WASM fixes (which were applied to the GB18030-mojibake tree) had to be redone against the freshly-BIG5-converted tree, since convert_lib.sh deletes and recreates work/ from raw/. WASM-specific fixes applied: (1) classic §8.1 GBK byte-range is_chinese()/check_legal_name() (parity gate, [i..<0] suffix slice, byte-doubled 2/12 bounds) fixed to per-codepoint 0x4e00-0x9fff and name[i..i], bounds halved to 1/6. (2) §7.12 tell_room() bare-exclude message() crash fixed with the standard exclude || ({}) guard. (3) master.lpc's valid_write() (valid_read() already unconditionally returns 1) got the standard 'user == this_object()' short-circuit. (4) §7.50 is_killing(object) vs is_killing(string id) fixed at 9 call sites (kungfu class roar/nuke files, several u/d/daniel/ NPC files, cmds/std/surrender.lpc). (5) 39 CRLF .o save files under data/ normalized to LF (restore_object() can choke on \r inside nested mappings). (6) GENUINE bug, not WASM-specific: adm/daemons/securityd.lpc's valid_write() checked 'file == user->query_save_file()' with exact string equality for the save_object() fast-path, but this driver's save_object() efun (vm/internal/base/object.cc) appends __SAVE_EXTENSION__ (.o) to the filename before invoking valid_write() -- the exact-match always failed, so save_object() was denied on EVERY player save (registration, world entry, quit), throwing 'Denied write permission in save_object()' every time. Fixed by comparing against query_save_file() + __SAVE_EXTENSION__ (matching the already-correct pattern found in this session's yhwhpublicfi/yxjh sibling libs -- yxsj's securityd.lpc was simply missing it). adm/daemons/ftpd.lpc and adm/daemons/network/dns_master.lpc are both dormant (commented out of adm/etc/preload, only guarded wizard-command callers) and were left untouched. Known non-blocking issues, not chased down further: adm/daemons/chinesed.lpc and adm/daemons/emoted.lpc both throw a caught, non-fatal 'Illegal mapping format while restoring dict/emote' at boot (same unexplained restore_object() failure signature seen on a different lib -- yxjh's named.lpc -- with different content, so likely a shared driver quirk rather than lib-specific corruption; degrades nothing observed in play). A transient 'apply() with insufficient permission... needs: private, has: hidden' for obj/user's command_hook appears during registration/login but does not block command processing, world entry, or quit. Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist ((admin) is this lib's top tier). Registration verified end-to-end pre- and post-formatter (English id -> y confirm -> Chinese name -> password + confirm -> email -> gender -> enters 士林高中/school gate area), admin permission confirmed via '目前權限﹕(admin)'. LPC formatter run across all 949 .lpc files (919 written, 21 pre-existing errors, 9 unchanged). No :: parent-call split hits, no case-label-with-trailing-comment candidates, no CJK-respacing/broken-escape hits.

yxxcii.name: 游侠笑传II (yxxcii)
yxxcii.reason: 游侠笑传II. Dual-encoding client support (prompts new connections to choose GB or BIG5 before login proceeds -- the BIG5-flavored prompt line is deliberately garbled when viewed as GBK, not a mojibake bug). WASM pass found and fixed a severe pre-existing (non-WASM-specific) bug: include/globals.h's SECURITY_D macro pointed at '/adm/obj/securityd', but the actual securityd.lpc file has always lived at 'adm/daemons/securityd.lpc' -- a path that was never valid. adm/etc/preload also referenced the wrong '/adm/obj/securityd' path, so master.lpc's own file_size()-gated preload() silently no-op'd on it (never actually loaded), and every OTHER preloaded daemon whose create() calls seteuid() (band, channeld, convertd, chinesed, combatd, fingerd, natured, saved, tengaoshou, tenrichman) crashed with 'call_other() couldn't find object /adm/obj/securityd' via master.lpc's unguarded valid_seteuid() -- worse, the very first player connection's logind.lpc create() (itself triggered via seteuid() during clone/user/login.lpc's compile) hit the same crash and the driver disconnected the user outright ('new_conn_handler: logon() ... has failed'). Fixed both the macro and the preload entry to the real path (also moved securityd to the FRONT of the preload list so every later daemon's seteuid() calls succeed). Also fixed: (1) classic §8.1 GBK byte-range is_chinese()/check_legal_name() bug (adm/daemons/chinesed.lpc's is_chinese() used a strlen%2 parity gate and str[0]-only byte check; adm/daemons/logind.lpc's check_legal_name() had the matching i%2==0/[i..<0] pattern) -- both rewritten to per-codepoint 0x4e00-0x9fff checks, bounds halved from 2/12 to 1/6. (2) master.lpc (adm/single/master.lpc) valid_read()/valid_write() missing the standard 'user == this_object()' short-circuit -- added to both (securityd.lpc's save_object() fast-path already correctly used query_save_file()+__SAVE_EXTENSION__, no fix needed there). (3) §7.50 is_killing(object) vs is_killing(string id) fixed across 49 call sites (mostly kungfu/skill/*.lpc roar/suck/zhua/shoot files using is_killing(me) and is_killing(ob[i]), plus d/city/npc/guidao.lpc, d/npc/robber.lpc, cmds/std/ansuan.lpc, cmds/std/surrender.lpc, cmds/std/nuoyi.lpc). zjmudhell.reason: extracted from a nested zip inside zjmud.7z (指间mud服务器+手机版客户端.zip), internally folder-named 'hell' -- unrelated to the existing hell/zjdywzb Century family, distinct master-hash. Fixed efun::message() exc_target=0 rejection; created missing /log/nosave dir. Same shujian3-lineage mobile-app protocol and custom logind.lpc. Full WASM pass needed: (1) crypt(ZJKEY, 0) client-handshake non-determinism (AGENTS.md §7.14) -- fixed to crypt(ZJKEY, "zj"), same as zhongjidiyu_zhijian; unlike shujian3, this lib's crypt-based ciphertext check in get_user() is NOT commented out and there's no comma-to-║ convenience replacement, so registration requires literal ║ separators and a real id/password ciphertext (crypt(ZJKEY,id)+crypt(ZJKEY,password)); (2) is_chinese() classic GBK byte-range check (§8.1) fixed to CJK codepoint range; (3) is_killing() object-vs-string arg mismatch in clone/user/user.lpc's accept_kill() (§7.50, third lineage to hit this); (4) three pure-socket daemons gutted per §7.52 (versiond.lpc -- 12 functions across create/in_server/connect_server/send_command/etc, NOT left "as-is" as the previous note said, since it was actually breaking questd.lpc's collect_all_quest_information() at runtime; payd.lpc HTTP payment callback; adm/daemons/network/dns_master.lpc intermud UDP layer). Admin (fluffos/Mud@2026) seeded via real registration + adm/etc/wizlist. score is correctly gated behind a 'born' flag for freshly-created characters (game design, not a bug) -- verified look+quit instead.

zuizhonghuanjing.description: 「最终幻境」（The Final Frontier，简称 FF）是一个改写自「东方故事II」(ES2) 函数库的太空科幻题材 MUD，由 Spock 创立——是本项目 ES II/东方故事大家族里罕见的科幻换皮版本，而非武侠题材。存档原为繁体中文（BIG5）内容，已转换为 UTF-8。
zuizhonghuanjing.name: 最终幻境 (The Final Frontier)

zxty.description: 《再现天涯》（游戏内横幅：梦回天涯）。和本次会话之前处理过的Doing 血统 `hell` 家族没有关系，但和 `tybxjh`/`wlhd`/`xhcii` 那个"天涯"家族是同源代码——`d/city/sj.lpc`（"世界之巅"跳崖场景）逐字节完全相同，此前处理这四份档案时都没有互相记录这层关系。档案里有一个巫师个人目录 `u/zjb/`，里面放了好几份核心系统文件的旧备份（`logind.lpc`、`master.lpc`、`securityd.lpc` 等）——用grep 确认过这些备份没有被任何活动路径引用（`include/globals.h`和 `config.fluffos` 里 `LOGIN_D`=`/adm/daemons/logind`、`MASTER_OB`=`/adm/obj/master`），所以本次只修了这两份真正生效的文件，`u/zjb/` 下的备份保持原样没动。
zxty.name: 再现天涯 (zxty)
zxty.reason: 再现天涯 (in-game banner: 梦回天涯 / 'Dream Return to Tianya'). Unrelated to the Doing-lineage 'hell' family processed earlier this session -- an independent ES-derived codebase, but with a nested wizard home directory (u/zjb/) containing multiple stale backup copies of core system files (logind.lpc, master.lpc, securityd.lpc) that are NOT referenced by any live path (LOGIN_D=/adm/daemons/logind, MASTER_OB=/adm/obj/master per include/globals.h and config.fluffos) -- confirmed via grep that nothing outside u/zjb/ references those backup copies, so only the two live files were touched; the backups were left untouched as inert dead code. WASM pass fixed: (1) A pre-existing (not introduced by this pass) boot-blocking compile error in the LIVE adm/daemons/logind.lpc: a stray leading ':' before 'string *banned_id = (...)' at line 28 produced 'error: modifier list may not be empty', which failed logind's compile entirely and disconnected every connecting user via new_conn_handler -- removed the stray colon. (2) check_legal_name()'s §8.1 GBK byte-range/parity bug: strlen bounds not halved (<4||>8 for a nominal '2 to 4 Chinese characters' -> fixed to <2||>4) and an i%2==0 parity gate that, combined with a single-codepoint is_chinese(name[i..<0]) helper, only validated every OTHER character was Chinese -- removed the parity gate so every character is checked. is_chinese() itself (adm/simul_efun/chinese.lpc) was already correct (checks str[0] as a per-codepoint 0x4e00-0x9fff range) and needed no fix. (3) master.lpc (adm/obj/master.lpc) valid_read()/valid_write() missing the standard 'user == this_object()' guard -- added to both. Confirmed NOT needed here: is_killing() (feature/attack.lpc) already takes an object parameter and every call site already passes an object -- no §7.50 type-mismatch bug exists in this lib. httpd.lpc, dns_master.lpc (via inetd.lpc), versiond.lpc, and closed.lpc all have real un-gutted socket_*() calls but NONE of them are in adm/etc/preload nor reachable from the login/registration path (VERSION_D and CLOSED_D are called from each other and from a handful of NPCs/cmds, all themselves unreachable at boot) -- left untouched as fully dormant, matching the established ftpd/dns_master precedent elsewhere in this project; confirmed via grep that no preloaded daemon or logind.lpc references any of them. log/nosave/ directory was missing (used by many non-boot-path features -- shell logging, crafting logs, item-eating logs) -- created it as a precaution though it was not boot-blocking here (logon()'s own log_file() calls are all to non-nosave paths). Admin seeded: fluffos (boss) in adm/etc/wizlist (this lib's top wizard rank string is '(boss)', not '(admin)' -- alongside the archive's pre-existing tangsheyu/baizhou/bzhou/baixzhou entries). Registration verified end-to-end pre- and post-formatter (English id -> y confirm -> single Chinese full name (2-4 chars, no surname/name split) -> admin password + confirm -> login password + confirm -> attribute-gift menu (0 for random) + confirm -> email address -> gender -> enters 有间客栈), admin permission confirmed via '您目前权限：(boss)'. One formatter blind-spot #3 hit (d/city/sj.lpc, pre-existing unbalanced quote causing CJK-respacing corruction) -- reverted via git checkout, confirmed the '\ n' signature was absent from the pre-format blob. LPC formatter run across all 13193 .lpc files (13067 written, 80 pre-existing errors, 46 unchanged, including the many dead files under u/zjb/). No :: parent-call split hits, no case-label-with-trailing-comment candidates.

zxty08nxgbb.description: 与 138/zxty 同一款游戏（"再现天涯"）的 2008 年修改重发布版本，master.lpc 内容不同、无精确 hash 匹配，但同名同源。
zxty08nxgbb.name: 再现天涯（08年修改版本）
zxty08nxgbb.reason: same 再现天涯 game as 138 (zxty), a 2008 modified re-release -- different master.lpc content, no exact hash match but same title/lineage; finished an interrupted conversion; reimplemented efun::tail() (§6.2); boots clean. Full WASM pass: added loopback-allow to band.lpc (this lineage bans anything that doesn't parse as a strict 4-part dotted-quad); fixed the same euid-reset-by-stray-seteuid(getuid()) bug in logind.lpc (create()/make_body()); fixed check_legal_name()'s stale GBK byte-length bounds and dropped the i%2==0 byte-pairing gate; fixed named.lpc's invalid_new_name() single-character-name rejection and its byte-stepping near-duplicate-name sliding window (rewritten to step by character, same bug and same fix as nt1's named.lpc -- this lineage shares the named.lpc/registration-room design with the NT/nitan family, not just jym); guarded securityd.lpc's get_status() defensively (mapp/arrayp checks, no reentrancy actually observed but cheap insurance). Admin seeded via the plain-text /adm/etc/wizlist file (this lineage's securityd.lpc reads it directly every boot, no save-file involved). Registration through world-entry, look/score/quit (quit correctly triggers this lineage's own 30-minute-anti-abuse confirmation prompt, not a bug), and admin recognition ("您目前权限：(admin)") all cleanly verified.

zzfy.description: 游戏登录后自报家门为"天下无敌"（压缩包标题"郑州风云3"是收藏者对这个具体服务器实例的称呼），属于风云（Fengyun）引擎系列，与本项目里的`fy2`/`fy2005`/`fengyun434`/`moniHuafu` 等同属一个大家族。
zzfy.name: 郑州风云3
zzfy.reason: 风云III engine base (郑州风云3)

zzfy3.description: 《郑州风云3》（游戏内横幅：风云系列之天下无敌）。以古龙小说为背景的风云系列 MUD，由长孙无情（Xgchen）建立，和 `wqfy`（无情风云，同样打着"天下无敌"横幅）是同一套"郑州风云"地图与代码库——`d/marry/hongniang-zhang.lpc` 逐字节相同，此前两份档案都没有互相记录这层关系。档案里有一个巫师个人目录 `u/wiz/u/xxy/`，里面是真正的游戏内容（武功/NPC 档案，不是死代码备份），另外还有几份真正没用的 `logind.lpc` 备份放在`d/wiz/xgchen/`、`u/wiz/u/china/`、`u/wiz/u/lxh/` 下——用`include/globals.h` 里的 `LOGIN_D`=`/adm/daemons/logind` 和`MASTER_OB`=`/adm/obj/master` 确认过只有`adm/daemons/logind.lpc` 和 `adm/obj/master.lpc` 是真正生效的，那几份 `logind.lpc` 备份没有动，但 `u/wiz/u/xxy/` 下的`is_killing()` 呼叫点是真正会被玩家碰到的游戏内容，**修了**。
zzfy3.name: 郑州风云3 (zzfy3)
zzfy3.reason: 郑州风云3 (in-game banner: 风云系列之天下无敌 / 'Invincible Under Heaven', a wuxia MUD in the Gu Long-novel-inspired Fengyun series, built by 长孙无情/Xgchen). Has a wizard home directory (u/wiz/u/xxy/) with real gameplay content (skill/NPC files, not dead system-daemon backups) plus a handful of genuinely dead logind.lpc backups under d/wiz/xgchen/, u/wiz/u/china/, u/wiz/u/lxh/ -- confirmed via LOGIN_D=/adm/daemons/logind and MASTER_OB=/adm/obj/master (include/globals.h) that only adm/daemons/logind.lpc and adm/obj/master.lpc are live; the logind.lpc backups were left untouched, but is_killing() call sites under u/wiz/u/xxy/ WERE fixed since those skill/NPC files are ordinary reachable gameplay content, not dead daemon copies. This lib's securityd.lpc is unusual: it does NOT use adm/etc/wizlist at all -- admin status is granted via a hardcoded 'set("wiz_status/xgchen","(admin)")' inside securityd.lpc's own restore_list(), re-applied on every boot, so the ONLY way to get admin on first boot is to register with the English id 'xgchen' (the original author's own wizard id) -- confirmed 'xgchen' is not in logind.lpc's banned_id list. WASM pass fixed: (1) check_legal_name()'s §8.1 byte-doubled bounds (<2||>12 for a nominal '1 to 6 Chinese characters' -> fixed to <1||>6) and an i%2==0 parity gate that, combined with a single-codepoint is_chinese() helper (str[0] check via name[i..<0] slicing), only validated every other character -- removed the parity gate. (2) master.lpc (adm/obj/master.lpc) valid_write() missing the standard 'user == this_object()' guard -- added (valid_read() here already unconditionally returns 1 with no securityd forwarding at all, so it needed no guard). (3) §7.50 is_killing(object) vs is_killing(string id) fixed at 25 call sites across daemon/class/*, cmds/daemon/class/* (a genuine parallel duplicate tree of daemon/, both populated with identical content -- fixed both since neither could be ruled out as dead), cmds/std/{surrender,nuoyi,kill}.lpc, d/wiz/xgchen/touxiang.lpc, and multiple skill/NPC files under u/wiz/u/xxy/ (kungfu skills, mei-po.lpc). Confirmed already correct: securityd.lpc's save_object valid_write() check already compares against query_save_file()+__SAVE_EXTENSION__. httpd.lpc and dns_master.lpc (both the adm/daemons/ copies and stale u/wiz/u/china, u/wiz/u/lxh backup copies) all have real un-gutted socket_*() calls but are commented out of adm/etc/preload and have no other reachable callers -- left fully dormant, matching the established pattern from other libs in this project; no versiond.lpc exists in this lib. log/nosave/ directory was missing -- created it as a precaution (not confirmed boot-blocking). Admin seeded implicitly via the hardcoded xgchen grant (no wizlist file to edit for this lib). Registration verified end-to-end pre- and post-formatter (English id 'xgchen' -> y confirm -> single Chinese name (1-6 chars) -> password + confirm -> email -> gender -> ethnicity menu (0-3, used 0 for 汉族) -> a 'press enter to continue' info-screen gate -> enters 凤求凰客栈), admin permission confirmed via '目前权限：(admin)'. This lib's prompt shows a live clock (matches AGENTS.md §8.3 item 1) -- used --idle 0.4 for registration testing. LPC formatter run across all 9224 .lpc files (9194 written, 20 pre-existing errors, 10 unchanged). No :: parent-call split hits, no case-label-with-trailing-comment candidates, no CJK-respacing/broken-escape hits.
